data.description: Win Percy Jackson's legendary sword, Riptide, by playing SFOTH: Percy Jackson Sea of Monsters Edition! Catch Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters in theaters August 7.

data.name: Common Egg Compass - Egg Hunt 2013
data.description: This item will only work in the official ROBLOX Egg Hunt 2013 level for the duration of this year's egg hunt.  This will point you in the direction of one of four common eggs.

data.name: Lightning McQueen Companion
data.description: Have Lightning McQueen by your side as you watch Disney•Pixar’s Cars 3 in Theaters June 16, 2017!

data.name: Flaming Mace
data.description: Strike your enemies and then light them on fire for extra damage!  Double click for a special fire attack!

data.name: Spring Sword of Growth
data.description: As spring plants grow, so does this sword.  One might wield it easily at first, but with each blox, it becomes larger and larger.

data.name: Heather's Axe
data.description: This weapon has a checkered past in Heather’s hands. Friend or foe, often it’s hard to tell. Not as hard is hitting folk with this axe, though!

data.name: Dark Summoner Staff
data.description: Summon a bunch of spooky undead creatures around you which will protect you and chase anybody nearby! Part of the Dark Summoner Package.

data.name: Levitating Staff of the Cosmos
data.description: Send your enemies flying into the deepest regions of the Robloxian universe.

data.name: Deluxe Mechatronic Spider
data.description: Click to spawn six deadly spiders. They will chase after any enemy daring enough to go near them. They deal five damage per hit, with six deadly spiders that adds up quickly! If close enough, they will shoot lasers from their robotic eye at you!

data.name: Halloween Paintball Gun
data.description: Get them while they last.  October only!

data.name: Bruin Fortune Hunter's Sword
data.description: A massive sword that you swing with such force that it does massive damage! Each swing it does 28 to 45 damage per hit. A Part of the Bruin Fortune Hunter package.

data.name: Telamax XR71 Shoulder Cannon
data.description: The Telemax XR71 Shoulder Cannon is a vital piece in every soldier's arsenal.  Shoot your enemies and revitalize yourself!

data.name: Angry Attack Squirrel
data.description: This fuzzy little guy attacks at your command!  He'll follow you around and attack anyone you click, doing ten damage per second.

data.name: Rapid Candy Launcher
data.description: Use this item in Hallow's Eve to rapidly fire candy at those treacherous monsters!  This item only works in Hallow's Eve. Play the game here -

data.name: Lillian's Moonglaive
data.description: Slices through objects like a hot knife through butter. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy! Check out www.roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Petrifying Pumpkin Scythe
data.description: You can't reason with a headless man. Part of the Petrifying Pumpkin package.

data.name: Sea Sorcerer Staff
data.description: Part of the sea sorcerer package!  Shoot bursts of water at your enemies, anybody caught in its path will be dealt 25 to 40 damage

data.name: Year of the Boar Lantern
data.description: Happy Lunar New Year! Celebrate the new year with your own ghostly guard boar to protect you.

data.name: Agent 99's Laser Goggles
data.description: Your mission can only be completed with the latest laser technology.  Aim lasers at people to do massive fiery damage.

data.name: Prismaboard
data.description: Shred through city streets on this purple prisma plank. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy! Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Icy Arctic Fowl
data.description: He may be fowl, but he's your friend.  Shoots painful iceblasts that do 25 damage to anyone near you.  Don't get too close to the Phoenix though, he'll melt your frozen friend.

data.name: Puppet Master
data.description: The puppet master runs the show!  Force others to do your bidding - and look silly.  Why?  No one asks the puppet master why.

data.name: Fusion Gatling Blaster
data.description: This gun has two modes; rapid-fire lasers, and a flamethrower attachment. You can alternate between the two by hitting the 'Q' key.  For the laser shots, you click and hold, and the upper barrel slowly begin to spin with a Gatling-fire like sound effect. It gets faster and louder, shooting projectiles more rapidly until it's at its maximum speed. This is rapid-fire, so there's dozens of lasers hitting your enemies all at once. They each do 8 damage.  The flamethrower, you click and hold as well, which a moderate sized flame blows out from the under-barrel of the gun.

data.name: RedBLOX
data.description: Getting ready to blox all night?  Me too.  Get some extra speed with RedBLOX.

data.name: Giant Dinosaur Feet
data.description: Stomp around ROBLOX in these giant dino feet! Every step you take will do 10 damage to nearby foes and knock them back. If you manage to jump on someone's head while wearing these prehistoric bad boys, you'll stomp them until their health is gone.

data.name: Tiger Strike Shuriken
data.description: Quick like a tiger, the six-pointed shuriken will sink its teeth into you before you see it coming. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy! Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Starfish Shuriken
data.description: Perfect for a ninja fight on the beach or in a boat!

data.name: Spy All Terrain Vehicle
data.description: Every spy needs a car that’s a boat, and a boat that’s a car.

data.name: Pumpkinade Launcher
data.description: Launch maniacal pumpkin bombs at your friends for fun and profit!

data.name: Korblox Flying Oblivion Horn
data.description: Korbloxians use this trumpet to summon death from above.  Once the trumpet sounds, Skeletal birds swoop in to destroy the Korblox's foes.

data.name: Valiant Adventurer Sword
data.description: Get this hood when you get the Valiant Adventurer package. http://www.roblox.com/Valiant-Adventurer-item?id=124908373

data.name: Rukiryo's ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: Rukiryo. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Ice Blue Rolling Hoverboard
data.description: Be blue cool when you’re rolling. Control your direction using arrow keys or the 'W', 'A', 'S', and 'D' keys while leaving snow behind you. Hit Backspace to dismount.

data.name: Bluesteel Claw
data.description: Embrace your inner beast!

data.name: Frosted Santa, Harbinger of Christmas Creep
data.description: The FIRST jingle announces his presence to the world. The SECOND jingle causes only chaos. The THIRD jingle offers great opportunity. The FOURTH jingle will be the last, and then, my friends, the music stops.

data.name: d4rk886's ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: d4rk886. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Bladed Ninja Claw
data.description: Click to slash at foes with your deadly dangerous ninja claw. Click and hold to charge the claw for an extra dangerous attack.

data.name: Ranger’s Apprentice: The Ruins of Gorlan
data.description: The Battle for Araluen Begins—Join the Adventure! Ranger’s Apprentice: The Ruins of Gorlan by John Flanagan

data.name: Emergency Rations
data.description: Increases your max health by 100 points.

data.name: Snowbot's Cane
data.description: Everyone goes crazy for a sharp dressed snowbot. Part of the Snowbot package.

data.name: Sorcus's Scythe Of Death
data.description:
Behold, all souls are mine; the soul of the father as well as the soul of the son is mine: the soul who sins shall die.
Available in the ROBLOX Halloween 2013: The Witching Hour event in Battle - http://www.roblox.com/Early-Beta-Access-Phase-2-Halloween-2013-The-Wi-place?id=130815926

data.name: Shark Launcher
data.description: What did you expect it to shoot?  Missiles?

data.name: Personal UFO
data.description: Drive your own personal UFO with up to 8 passengers! Use 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' or arrow keys to control the direction and 'Q' to raise the UFO, 'E' to lower it. Click and hold to suck up players beneath you into the ship and press 'T' while they are in the beam to teleport players into an open seat on your UFO. Use ' L' to control your sweet UFO lights.

data.name: Spec Alpha Biograft Energy Sword
data.description: This sword biografts to your character amps your jumping capabilities. Double click and jump at the same time to superjump. Also, if you get close to anyone, you will positively wreck them. Yes, the future is a dangerous place.

data.name: Bug Juice
data.description: It doesn't come in a jar. It comes from who you are.  But seriously - this stuff will make you jump like there are 100 spiders after you.

data.name: Opened Chosen Basket of the Overseer
data.description: He is the chosen one. Inside you find... Overseer Chosen.

data.name: Glorious Sword
data.description: A sword of unfathomable power, laid buried in the sands of time till now.

data.name: Santa's Big Bag O' Toys
data.description: "He's got a sleighfull, / that's not gonna stay-full / He's got stuff to drop at every stop on the way / Everybody's waitin' for the man with the bag, / 'Cause christmas is comin' again. "

data.name: Spiral Knight Crossbow
data.description: Part of the Spiral Knight Package.  http://www.roblox.com/Spiral-Knight-item?id=108235056

data.name: Celestial Staff
data.description: Summon the rage of the skies!

data.name: Neon Bloxster
data.description: Neon colored reskin of the Bloxster 2XH. Emits neon-blue like exhaust smoke instead of grey. Holding the shift key allows you to do a wheelie like move. The 'X' key toggles the head light in front of the vehicle.

data.name: Super-G LS33 Disruptor
data.description: The Super-G LS33 Disruptor is banned throughout the Federation. It's use against other Robloxians is classified as a war crime.

data.name: Trusty Blade
data.description: This well rounded sword is well suited for blocking daggers, but vulnerable to bigger blades.  Does 35 damage per attack.

data.name: Epic Golden Sword and Shield
data.description: Click to swing dealing 15 to 22 damage; double click to spin-dash at your opponent while on fire!

data.name: Blue Fidget Spinner
data.description: True blue, too cool. The fidget spinner will spin when you click on it and each time you click on it, the faster it will spin.

data.name: Orbital Flute Strike
data.description: Imagine for a moment, you are peacefully playing a beautiful melody on your flute, when suddenly you see a flaming missile.  You realize that you are controlling its direction with your sweet music.  Where do you send it? That choice is yours and yours alone.

data.name: Bigfoot Feet Slippers
data.description: Pretty sure these are your size….Equip to move at a blurring speed.

data.name: Judge Underwood's Gavel
data.description: No you're out of order!  This whole trial's out of order!

data.name: Hulk Hands
data.description: Just make sure to do your breathing exercises if you get too angry. And remember, with great power comes great responsibility, to SMASH!

data.name: Pumpkin Trick or Treat Pail
data.description: No costume is complete without something for storing the night’s haul of candy in!

data.name: Hawkeye’s Bow and Arrow
data.description: Can’t get within reach of your opponent? No problem! Use your bow and arrow to reach every single one of them from a distance.

data.name: Mackerel
data.description: Holy Mackerel! This fish smarts!

data.name: Holiday Ham
data.description: Best way to stay healthy and strong this holiday season?  Enjoy some of this holiday ham!  Doubles your health!

data.name: Zeus's Lightning Bolt Staff
data.description: Hurl lightning at your enemies.  Because they probably deserve it.

data.name: ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
data.description: Click to dump this ice water on another player, press 'q' to dump it on yourself!  Proceeds will benefit ALS research.

data.name: From the Vault: Bandit Dog
data.description: From the vault of interns past, ROBLOX brings you - this bandit dog! Dued1's dog barks at you!

data.name: Pua
data.description: Moana’s faithful companion is here to join you on your journeys! Be sure to see Disney’s Moana, in theatres November 23 in 3D!

data.name: Insert Tool
data.description: An Insert tool for building with sets

data.name: Deluxe Vine Staff
data.description: Call forth a circle of vines from the earth.  If your foes hit them they will do 20 damage.

data.name: Sorcus' Chair
data.description: This is how he rolls...and trolls....  Sorcus' Chair came out of the Surly Gift of Sorcus II on October 26th, 2012.

data.name: Opened Basket of Ultimate Troll
data.description: Inside this basket is a troll top hat. Don't feed the trolls. Inside you find... Troll Top Hat.

data.name: Gigantic Crossbow
data.description: They'll know who's boss when you show up with your giant crossbow! Fire huge arrows at your foes to deal 20 damage per hit. Double click to strike your foes with the crossbows blades. This attack will do 30-40 damage per hit.

data.name: Chocolate Milk
data.description: Yes, there is an irritating slurping noise.

data.name: Sword of Ancalagon
data.description: More than a mere sword, this amazing tool shoots Ancalagon's own Dragon Fire at anyone in the area.

data.name: Bat-tle Axe
data.description: Can I AXE you a question? I promise to get my POINT across.

data.name: Eccentric Time Keeper's Sword
data.description: Part of the Eccentric Time Keeper Package.  Available when you redeem a $40 ROBLOX card from GameStop in January.

data.name: Summer Hang Glider
data.description: Soaring through the sky all summer long!

data.name: 2013 Sparkler
data.description: Say hello to 2013!

data.name: Zombie STOPing Axe
data.description: Stop a zombie attack DEAD in its tracks. Swing this axe at enemies; dealing 15 damage each hit.

data.name: Protest Sign: Save the Whales
data.description: Some people think nuking whales is wrong... And they're not going to take it any more!

data.name: Explosive Super Glider
data.description: With the click of a mouse you are airborne. While in the air, you can drop deadly bombs on your enemies. The bombs do 100 damage per hit, but they have a small radius.  Aim carefully.

data.name: Flame Guard General Sword
data.description:
Click to swing the sword and spawn a row of red ice crystals out in front of you. They'll burst in flames and anybody too close and hit by the shards is dealt 10 damage per hit! The closer you are to these, the more dangerous they are.

Part of the Flame Guard General package.

data.name: 8-Bit Crossbow
data.description: This 8-bit crossbow deals 20 damage upon impact on a player.

data.name: Korblox Hunter's Bow
data.description: Click and hold to pull the arrow and charge it up to do maximum damage. Part of the Korblox Hunter Package.

data.name: Katana
data.description: The katana originated in the Muromachi period (1392–1573) as a result of changing battle conditions requiring faster response times. The katana facilitated this by being worn with the blade facing up, which allowed the samurai to draw and cut their enemy in a single motion. Previously, the curved sword of the samurai was worn with the blade facing down. The ability to draw and cut in one motion also became increasingly useful in the daily life of the samurai.

data.name: ROBLOX Portable Game System (RPGS)
data.description:
A 2d game in a 3d game?  You betcha!  Controls - : "d" is forward
 "a" is backward
 "w" is jump
 "left click" is shoot

data.name: Navy Convertible
data.description: Get out of my game, and into my car! To drive use 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', or the arrow keys. Hit 'X' to toggle headlights and 'H' to honk.

data.name: Sword of Unvanquished Snakes
data.description: It's said that Saint Patrick rid Ireland of snakes.  What do you think he did with them?  Put them in the sword of course!  Now you can use this sword's special attack to send 15 snakes slithering dangerously towards your foes.  Also functions as a regular sword and does 10 damage per hit.

data.name: Winged Magical Staff
data.description: The perfect tool for fighting evil in the daylight or moonlight. Double jump to fly.  Control using 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' or arrow keys. Click to shoot neon pink orbs at your enemies!

data.name: Exploding Arrow Crimson Crossbow
data.description: This crimson crossbow fires an arrow that sticks to the first thing it hits and explodes after about 2 seconds. The explosion deals between 10 and 110 damage based on how long the arrow was flying through the air.

data.name: Fortune Cookie
data.description: Nom nom nom... A mysterious stranger will be the key to my success?  Silly cookie...cookies are for eating...not prophesying...

data.name: Valkyrie Sword
data.description:
An enchanted weapon once wielded by a mythical warrior. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Memorial Day Fireworks
data.description: These glorious fireworks will have you glowing in their sparkles all night long!  These fireworks look great in places with dynamic lighting enabled.

data.name: Trick or Trap Jackolantern
data.description: Place this tricky little pumpkin in the ground.  It will grow and call out to other players.  If the players touch the pumpkin they will receive a trick or a treat.  The trick is a deadly explosion.  The treat is a delicious chocolate bar.

data.name: Trophy of Participation 2016
data.description: This trophy stands as proof that this user earned the heely-wheely item that was available during a 2016 event.

data.name: Steampunk Attack Birds
data.description: These friendly birds will fly around you, protecting you from anyone who comes near.  They'll swoop down and attack, doing 25 damage per hit!

data.name: Heartbreak
data.description: Ow! Papercuts!

data.name: Scuba Gear Starfish
data.description: You meet the friendliest people in the ocean. Click to throw at your target to obscure their vision. Part of the Scuba Pro package.

data.name: My Big Fat Zombie Goldfish: The Seaquel
data.description: Prepare to be zombie-fied! Start reading MY BIG FAT ZOMBIE GOLDFISH: THE SEAQUEL now!

data.name: Gravity Coil
data.description: Equipping this item cancels 75% of gravity's effect on your character. This allows you to jump extra high, or to fall like a feather from great heights.

data.name: Duelling Glove
data.description: Good sir, I challenge you to a duel!  A slapping duel!

data.name: Chocolate Bunny
data.description: Eating this yummy chocolate bunny will give you a sugar high that makes you run at lightning fast bunny speeds.

data.name: Haunted Pizza
data.description: Take a bite out of this spooky haunted pizza and become a ghost!  You'll get ghost super speed after eating this pizza!

data.name: Golden Super Fly Boombox
data.description: Nothin' but the hits. Play the hottest jams on ROBLOX all over town.

data.name: Orb Crystal Launcher
data.description: Launch your crystals quickly for instant damage. Charge it for a bit and then launch?  Your foe is in a world of trouble.

data.name: A Very Special Monster
data.description: He has big big plans, but small small teeth.

data.name: Ice Cream
data.description: I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice cream!

data.name: Fang of Tsuchigumo
data.description:
Beware this venom in the form of a blade. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Footbag
data.description: Have some colorful fun with this colorful footbag! Pull off some cool moves and show it off to your friends! Time to enjoy the summer!

data.name: Cool Story Air Conditioner
data.description: Remember that time 4 air conditioners fell from the sky simultaneously. Cool story, bro.

data.name: Astral Cloak of Transportation
data.description: All magical secrets are held by the Wizards of the Astral Isles, but they don't mind lending out this cloak.  Just don't ask how it gets you from A to B.

data.name: Giant Ape Arms
data.description: Equip this gear to get gorilla-like arms. Clicking makes you punch, and any  player you hit with your fists will feel the wrath of the ape king!

data.name: Monster Fierce Basher
data.description: This aweseome bashing stick has a ton of ways for you to bring the pain to your foes.  If your enemies touch the stick they will take 5-8 damage. If hit by a swing they can expect 10-15 damage. Double click to do 20-25 damage or click and hold to super charge your swing and do 25-40 points of damage.

data.name: Deadly Laser Vision Polar Bear Mount
data.description: Rideable polar bear that shoots deadly laser beams out of his eyes. Hop on his back and use 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', or the arrow keys to move around. Click to shoot deadly lasers from the polar bears eyes. If hit, your opponent will take 40-70 points of damage.  Disclaimer- this is not a real polar bear. No polar bears were harmed in the making of this virtual polar bear robot. Please do not attempt to ride polar bears irl. Please do not attempt to attach lasers to real polar bears. Does not require batteries.  Is virtual.  Is subject to additional disclaimers in very small print below the bottom of this visible text. Not really though. If you meet a polar bear - please be cool and don't approach it.  This is actually good advice for pretty much any bear.

data.name: Deluxe Beach Ball
data.description: Hit the ball back and forth with friends.  Just another chill day on the ROBLOXIAN beachfront.

data.name: Alvin
data.description: The cavalier leader of the band Alvin and the Chipmunks. Be sure to find him before he ends up continuing on his “Road Chip”. Be sure to catch Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip in theaters December 18!

data.name: Super Spy Drone
data.description: In the future everything will be delivered by drone. The future is now. Use the remote control to fly, 'Q' and 'E' to more up or down.

data.name: 2014 Fireworks
data.description: 2014 swiftly approaches... but it's not quite as swift as these 2014 rockets! Light up the night with these sweet fireworks!

data.name: Staff of Neverending Frost
data.description: Freeze your enemies solid!

data.name: Merica Airwalker
data.description: Cuz this is my United States of Whatever....

data.name: Father's Day Card 2010
data.description: Father, dad, papa, vater, padre or pere.  Call him whatever you like, but make sure that he knows you appreciate him today!

data.name: RDC 2016 Game Jam Trophy
data.description: Game on! This trophy was awarded to the top three finalist teams in the 2016 RDC Game Jam held in San Jose in August 2016.

data.name: Giant Iron Sword of Sundering
data.description: This giant sword can only be wielded by the strongest of Robloxians.  Are you up for the challenge?

data.name: Bluster Buster
data.description: Harness air power to defeat your foes!  I'm not talking about planes.

data.name: Witches Brew
data.description: Do the Brew! Shipped direct from the Haunted Hill soda company. Warning: may cause freakish deformities. Warning: may contain actual witches.

data.name: Giant Kaiju Arms
data.description: Equip this gear to get monster-like arms. Clicking makes you punch, so you're ready for any fight.

data.name: Hedgehog Horde
data.description: Release the hedgehogs!  Click on enemies to get your hedgehogs to attack them!

data.name: Amerilaser Blaster
data.description: Blast your foes all the way back to 1776.  Looks great in places with dynamic lighting enabled!

data.name: Pumpkin Pi
data.description: This is for everyone who complained that the last contest was too easy... MUAHAHAHAHAAHAHAHAHAHAHA!

data.name: DarkAge Ninjas: Combat Potion
data.description:
The DarkAge Ninjas are masters of hand to hand combat that none but the fiercest of warriors can handle. 

Drink this potion to increase your vitality to two fold, and to learn to spin kick, flash kick and charge kick in the face, decimating anyone who tries to fight you.

data.name: Stone Roped
data.description: Old fashioned look meets new fashioned technology. Works with standard roped controls.

data.name: Sword of the Autumnal Winds
data.description: Leafing your enemies in your dust....

data.name: Harbinger of Fimbulwinter
data.description: Arm yourself in preparation for the Battle for Midgard! Mete out icy punishment with this heavy iron hammer. In the arms of a true Ice God, this weapon becomes especially potent.

data.name: Captain Skeledeath's Axe
data.description: Part of the Captain Skeledeath package.  This axe does 16 damage per hit. Double click to do a special skeledamage attack which does 25 points of damage.

data.name: DarkAge Kunai
data.description: Throw 5 at once!  Upon equipping a kunai, you can click 4 more time in the next 1.5 seconds to equip all five!  Each deals 15 damage.

data.name: Galaxy Zack: Hello, Nebulon!
data.description: Read the first chapter of Hello, Nebulon!, the latest book from the Galaxy Zack series.  This book is available in stores on April 2nd, 2013.

data.name: Penguin Shooter
data.description: Left click to fire a baby penguin from the launcher. The baby penguin will jump around, dealing up to 10 damage each second for 10 seconds. You can have 15 baby penguins running around at a time for a full on penguin swarm!

data.name: Spring-loaded Jumping Stilts
data.description: Tower above your fellow Robloxians in these spring-loaded jumping stilts.  Then jump around. Jump around. Jump up jump up and get down.

data.name: Overseer Sword & Shield
data.description: Click to swing your sword forward, dealing between 22 and 25 damage. Double click to spawn green flames and lunge forward, dealing double the damage.

data.name: Pompous, the Cloud
data.description: Fly this cumulus cloud all over ROBLOX.

data.name: Ice Cream Skateboard
data.description: That's one sweet board, bro.

data.name: Race the Sunset
data.description: Another original ROBLOX 2D game.  Can you beat the sunset?

data.name: 4th of July Rocket
data.description: It's amazing what modern Robloxian pyrotechnics can do!

data.name: Danger Dagger
data.description: This dagger is perfect for close range combat, this dagger lets you run and strike faster than normal.

data.name: BLOXY 2015
data.description: This award was given out to the winners of the 3rd Annual BLOXY Awards, honoring the best game creators, builders, artists, and video makers on ROBLOX.

data.name: Artemis Bow
data.description: The Artemis Bow features two attack modes--you can charge a concentrated death shot that does up to 100 damage, or shoot in rapid fire mode for more arrows that deal 12 damage each.But that's not all - you can also use it to fly! When you jump, the Artemis Bow will grow wings and allow you to take flight.

data.name: Above Top Secret Jetpack
data.description: An essential gadget for every spy.

data.name: Jungle Explorer Boomerang
data.description: Give it a toss to send foes flying.  Part of the Jungle Explorer package.

data.name: Tomahawk
data.description: Long distance danger - free of charge!

data.name: Red Rebels Paintball Gun
data.description: We're going to paint the town red!  Literally...

data.name: 8-Bit Pumpkin Launcher
data.description: It's dangerous to trick or treat alone, take this! Click to lob 8-bits of bursting pumpkins at your foes.

data.name: Ninja Sai
data.description: The primary melee weapon of the Shadow Ninjas, the Sai, comes in two pieces to wreak its opponents. With its lightness and speed it also allows the wearing Ninja the ability to move faster.

data.name: Egg Compass
data.description: Points you towards the rarest egg in the level. Re-use often, in case the egg is moving.

data.name: Ghost Blaster
data.description: This blaster will down your foes with just one hit!  But that's not all - your foe will come back as  your ghost minion and attack other players for 30 seconds.

data.name: RoboDog
data.description: All the fun of a dog without ever having to worry about remembering to feed it. And if it keeps barking at the neighbors you can just turn it off

data.name: Seagull Friend
data.description: Click to summon three seagull guardians who fly around you with their watchful seagull eyes.  If an enemy comes 60 studs of your character, the seagulls swoop down and they blast your enemies with powerful beams of water! Each blast does 13 damage per hit.

data.name: Sapphire Blaster
data.description: Get the sapphire blaster for free when you redeem a ROBLOX Card from Walmart in August (2011).

data.name: Grand Samurai Katana
data.description: When the world is at peace, a gentleman keeps his sword by his side. Click to hack and slash your opponents up to 12 damage. Part of the Grand Samurai package.

data.name: Subspace Tripmine
data.description: WARNING: HIGH EXPLOSIVE DEVICE. When triggered, this devastating weapon rips a gashing hole in the fabric of reality - subsequent spacetime reification results in a large explosion. USE: Drop mine. Once the mine stops moving, it will enter subspace and become invisible. At this point the mine is armed. Touching the mine will set it off...

data.name: OBC Skateboard
data.description: Outrageous Builders Club members love their bolting bling of a black and gold board. Rock on.

data.name: Orange You Jealous XD
data.description: Awarded to the winners of the Skaters in Giant World building contest, March 2010. *It's a gear item but currently showing up as a hat. We're working to fix it. Thanks!*

data.name: Dual Illumina
data.description: Light and deadly- twice as deadly as a single Illumina!  This item came out of the Coolest Gift on December 21st, 2012.

data.name: Black Iron Mace of Pwnage
data.description: Dispatch your enemies with extreme prejudice. Swings slow, but does a lot of damage if it hits.

data.name: Positronic Platform Producer
data.description: Has a wall got you down, literally? Combat gravity the old-fashioned way with Positronic Platform Producer! Simply shoot at a wall to create a platform to stand on. Don’t get too comfortable though, as converting energy into mass can still prove to be a bit unstable, especially with walls that contain anchoritium.

data.name: Vampire Hunter's Crossbow
data.description: Part of the Vampire Hunter package.  A crossbow with a deadly axe attached. Click to fire arrows at your enemies, dealing 18 damage per hit with a half a second fire rate.

data.name: Carrot Slingshot
data.description: Sling deadly carrots at your enemies!! Click to release the string and launch a carrot in the direction of your cursor. Roughly 10 damage is dealt to any enemies hit.

data.name: Pigs Boson Collider
data.description: Utilizing the Large Hilarity Collider, researchers created the conditions immediately after the Big Chuckle and discovered the emergence of the Pigs Boson, the fundamental particle of funny that will destroy your target for hilarity.

data.name: Jovial Jester's Staff
data.description: Spread joy and cheer, by order of the king! Part of the Jovial Jester package.

data.name: Bejeweled Sword of Great Fury
data.description: Do you see red or blue?  This fierce sword lets you switch between Ruby and Sapphire attacks.  In Ruby mode you deal 40 damage per hit, but take 15 damage yourself. In Sapphire mode you do 15 damage per hit, but can strike at a great speed, and heal yourself with each hit you land.

data.name: Blinged Gold Motorcycle
data.description: Ride this bike your way. And with style.

data.name: Ernesto De La Cruz’s Guitar
data.description: The legendary musician's famous guitar - it still plays like the first day it was strung! Play it with pride and use it to seize your moment, sponsored by Disney's/Pixar's Coco.

data.name: Moana’s Paddle
data.description: Bring Moana’s Paddle on your own adventures and use it to ward off evil! Be sure to see Disney’s Moana, in theatres November 23 in 3D!

data.name: Deluxe Slime Ray
data.description: He slimed me! A rapid fire slime gun; can fire quickly with a short reload time. Shoot projectiles of slime at your opponents which do 8 damage upon striking them and obscure their screen in slime temporarily!

data.name: Implosion Bomb
data.description: Click once and then toss the bomb onto the ground- away from yourself of course! The implosion bomb will beep for five seconds and then implode. Everything flies inward and anyone hit will take 100 damage points!

data.name: Cy the Cyborg - Gun
data.description: In the future, man's best friend...is machine.

data.name: Dragon Companion
data.description: The smallest dragons often work as scouts or traveling companions throughout the misty forests of the far north. This friend will follow you faithfully though any adventure.

data.name: Acursed Mummy Hand of Head Shot
data.description: BOOM! Headshot!

data.name: Shuriken of the Clan of the Crescent Moon
data.description: A superior man is modest in his speech, but exceeds in his actions.

data.name: Green Elf Bow
data.description: Click and hold to charge your arrows.  Depending on how long it's charged, damage can range between 9 and 33. If fully charged, you can fire three arrows at once, dealing around 70 to 80 damage!

data.name: Coco - Family Portrait
data.description: A reminder of times long past, but memories not forgotten. The most precious prize of all is family so cherish this portrait as if it were your own.

data.name: Winter Adventurer's Sword
data.description: Click to slash; double click to lunge. Dealing roughly 20 damage per hit. Part of the Winter Adventurer's package.

data.name: Breath of Ice
data.description: Swallow the frost and spit out ice at your foes!

data.name: Zombie Crossbow
data.description: Click to fire an arrow, dealing 15 damage each. There is a 20% chance of poisoning your enemy, which does a about 15 more damage over a 4 second period, while slowing you down while it takes its effect.

data.name: Wakandan Shield
data.description: See Captain America fight to save the universe in Marvel Studios Avengers: Infinity War. In theaters April 27th!

data.name: Beehive
data.description: Drop the beehive to summon killer bees. The bees do 4 damage on impact and there are 15 clusters doing a total of 60 damage per second.

data.name: Star Hammer
data.description: Great men don't watch the stars, great men forge the stars.

data.name: Chakram
data.description: Basically this is a flying ring with one very sharp edge all the way around. It hits hard, but has a long cool down time. It's best used to pick off enemies who are already damaged, or to seriously soften them up before entering melee combat.

data.name: Leprechaun Friend
data.description: You're lucky he likes you.

data.name: Adurite Katana
data.description: Harness the heat of your rage with this adurite katana.

data.name: Dragon's Blaze Sword
data.description: Straight from the dragon's mouth - a flame to consume all.  Your received this sword for free if you redeemed a ROBLOX card from GameStop from February 1st, 2013 to February 28th, 2013.

data.name: simoon68's ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: simoon68. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Super Speedy Purple Potion
data.description: This speed potion is very nearly perfect.  Once activated your walk speed will be increased to 50.  One side effect we should mention is that you will turn temporarily purple and sparkly.  Like we said ... very nearly perfect.

data.name: Frostooth the Frozen Treasure Chest
data.description: Freeze your foes who would try and steal your treasure!

data.name: Great White Mount
data.description: Take a bite out of the sky with this hovering friendly shark.

data.name: Winter Wolf Warrior's Mace
data.description: Part of the winter wolf warrior package.  Click to whack your enemy on the head, dealing randomly between 15 and 20 damage.

data.name: Turkey Mount
data.description: Just like how the pilgrims used to ride turkeys at the first Thanksgiving. I saw it in a comic book.

data.name: Egg Cannon 9000
data.description: The Egglord's personal armament. It ONLY works in the 2012 ROBLOX Egg Hunt level and it allows you spawn eggs for other players to find...

data.name: Noxious Chocolate
data.description: Share this candy with your enemies.  Forces them to eat the candy (which is poisonous) and causes them to drop their weapons!

data.name: 8-Bit Ninja Stars
data.description: Ow! Those pixels are sharp!

data.name: Mythic Sword of the West Wind
data.description: May you slash with all the colors of the wind. Slash your enemies, dealing 18 to 33 damage. Enemies also get pushed back from the force of the wind. Hit the 'Q' key, to activate the special attack causing you to spin around in circles and blow away nearby enemies.

data.name: Pirate Throwing Axes
data.description: Yer foes don't stand a chance when you got yer trusty pirate axes.  Click to throw two hatchets at your foes. Each hatchet does 28 damage. If you're really lucky and both hit, that's a combined 56 total damage!

data.name: Snowman Cannon
data.description: Launches your snowman sentries far and wide!  Your snowman foot soldiers will lock on an enemy target and fire away!

data.name: Katana of the Golden Snake
data.description: Click to slash dealing 22 damage. When your opponent least expects it, double click to dash at him and strike dealing up to 50 damage!

data.name: Giant Blade
data.description: This giant blade is extremely powerful and does 45 damage. The blade's weight will slow you down slightly, but  when you're doing this much damage - it's hard to notice.

data.name: Winter Warlock Wand
data.description: What is this, some kinda trick?! Part of the Winter Warlock Bundle.

data.name: Big Hero 6 Baymax
data.description: Get Baymax as your sidekick and bring him home today with Big Hero 6 on Digital HD & Disney Movies Anywhere, and Blu-ray™ Feb 24!

data.name: Jingle Bell Launcher
data.description: Make sure your enemies know the REAL holiday spirit with this launcher!

data.name: Vilicus' ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: Vilicus. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Dragon Tooth Power Up
data.description:
Hold the tooth to fly into the sky like Elliot.

You hold it, you jump to fly, and you'll come down slowly.

data.name: Opened Violet  Basket of Equal Cosmic Time
data.description: Everything is in perfect balance. Inside you find... violet equinox.

data.name: Protest: ROBLOXians Against SOPA
data.description: ROBLOX is against online censorship. Read our full position on SOPA/PIPA here: http://blog.roblox.com/2012/01/stop-online-piracy-act-sopa-and-roblox-our-stance/. If you agree, show your support with this sign!

data.name: Phantom Forces Combat Knife
data.description:
Looking for a fight? This is sharp, intimidating, and shiny. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Trophy of Wheeled Participation 2014
data.description: This trophy stands as proof that this user earned the off-roading item (10) that was available during a 2014 event.

data.name: Overseer Mace
data.description: Overseers understand the universal language of smashing things with a mace. Click to bash your opponents with this mighty weapon.

data.name: Newt’s Magical Case
data.description: What sort of magic can you find? Aboard the hunt on Roblox to find out. Be sure to watch Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald on 11.16!

data.name: Robot Rock Guitar
data.description: Roboboogie. Hit keys: 'Z', 'X', 'C', 'V', 'B', 'N' to play different notes.

data.name: 4th of July Fireworks 2018
data.description: Celebrate the 4th with a BANG!

data.name: Lightning Wand
data.description: You control the weather now. Science!  Click your Lightning Rod to fire bolts of lightning in any direction you like.

data.name: Formula R Remote Control Car
data.description: Simply click the steering wheel of the RC Car to deploy (or click again to bring it back to you), and use the regular walking keys (WASD) to move your new vehicle.

data.name: Lunar Lander 2D Game
data.description: Land on the crate and get it home safely.  One of the most challenging 2D games yet!

data.name: Mystic Sword of the Flames
data.description: Courage is fire. Slash away at your enemies and leave behind a burning trail of death.  This sword does 15 - 22 damage per swing, trail burns 5 damage per step.

data.name: Nerf Candy Basket
data.description: This is Advertising. Engage in the festivities with the basket of goodies!

data.name: Fermion Blade
data.description: Beware the wrath of the holder of the Fermion Blade. It may look cheerful, but after feeling its power, you probably won't be.

data.name: Sinister Flying Magic Carpet
data.description: Dark magic gives this carpet the ability to fly.  Use it to fly high above other ROBLOX players.

data.name: Luger Pistol
data.description: The WW2 Luger is an old school war relic that lets you target different limbs for different affects. Shoot a player in the leg, and they'll walk a quarter slower. Shoot them in the arm, and they'll drop their weapon. Body shots do 20 hit points of damage.

data.name: BLOXY 2014
data.description: This shiny BLOXY Award is awarded to the few and proud winners of ROBLOX's 2014 International Film Festival.

data.name: Personal Fighter Jets
data.description: Mini jet fighters that strike at your command! They'll circle your head until you are ready to unleash the fury!

data.name: Magnificent Magenta Paintball Gun
data.description: Everyone's screen can always use a little more magenta.

data.name: Mr. Peabody & Sherman's WABAC Machine
data.description: Use Mr. Peabody’s WABAC Machine to travel back in time & space to wherever you left it. Be sure to catch Mr. Peabody & Sherman in theaters March 7!

data.name: RobloTim's RobloHunk Potion
data.description: Want to be the next superstar in town? Then this potion is for you! Brewed by our very own RobloTim, this potion make you into a solid weight lifting champion. Huge muscles, strong arms and giving + 100% health and movement speed! Once transformed you can use other gear to fight or show off!

data.name: Blade of the Dusekkar
data.description:
Stand back! This explosive blade is built for battle! Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy! 

Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Spider Horde
data.description: Whats better than one spider? Why not three!?

data.name: The Fiery Sun
data.description: Launch the sun up like a toy.  Don't forget to find some shades and a hat though, I hear looking directly at the sun can blind you.

data.name: Chopper Broom
data.description: Hey bud, wanna race? Equip and click and drag to rev your engine and fly around in the direction of your cursor.

data.name: Maaus, the Battle Lion
data.description: Ride into battle with strength and courage.

data.name: Ghostwalker
data.description:
The boast of heraldry, the pomp of power, /
And all that beauty, all that wealth e'er gave, /
Awaits alike th' inevitable hour:- /
The paths of glory lead but to the grave.

data.name: BFG Gobblefunk Dictionary
data.description: Gobblefunk is the language of Giant Country. Can you decipher the words in this magical book?

data.name: ROBLOX U Free Stuff Launcher
data.description: Stuff! People love stuff!  Launch free pizza and tee shirts from this cannon.

data.name: Laservision Shades G3
data.description: ROBLOX brings you Laservision! Shoot  lasers from your eyes like a CIA agent!  Sweet!

data.name: Protest Sign: Egg Hunt Nao
data.description: What do we want?  Egg Hunts!  When do we want them?  Soonish!

data.name: Motherboard Sword
data.description: Send them crying for their mother(boards) faster than you can say nanoprocesser.

data.name: Board With a Nail in It
data.description: Did they? That board with a nail in it may have defeated us. But the humans won't stop there. They'll make bigger boards and bigger nails, and soon, they will make a board with a nail so big, it will destroy them all!

data.name: Nonmagic Carpet
data.description: This carpet used to be magic.  You bought it at a rug shop from a crying salesman because the situation was really awkward... Still it's cool to think that princesses and tigers used to fly around on this thing you just walk on when you enter the foyer.

data.name: Accursed Vampire Bat Hand
data.description: Send bats flying towards your enemies.  Not only do they do damage, they come and bring your foe's health right back to you!

data.name: Jack Frost
data.description: He's worse than the Christmas Creep!

data.name: Wooden Mallet
data.description: Woo-woo- woo!  Win this prize by playing "Welcome to Stoogeville" and winning as Curly!  Be sure to catch the Three Stooges Movie - in theaters April 13th.  Check out the game here - http://www.roblox.com/Welcome-to-Stoogeville-place?id=74885275  Tag - 3 Stooges, Moe, Curly, Larry

data.name: Metal Guitar of Awesomeness
data.description: You'll have all your friends dancing when you play the Metal Guitar of Awesomeness.  Get the Metal Guitar of Awesomeness for free when you purchase a ROBLOX Card at Walmart during the month of September..

data.name: Sword Of The Behemoth - a Walmart Exclusive
data.description: "Hark! Hark to the wind! / 'Tis the night, they say, / When all souls come back from the far away-- / The dead, forgotten this many a day!"

data.name: Double Bladed Hand Axe
data.description: Lemme axe you something.

data.name: Shuri’s Gauntlets
data.description: Princess of Wakanda, Shuri possesses strength and power to lead. Display your achievements of conquering Roblox Innovation 2018 by displaying these gauntlets.

data.name: Elf Launcher
data.description: This is a sure way to get on the naughty list. Fire elf dolls at your foes with this festive launcher.

data.name: Speedy Hiking Boots
data.description: You'll make it to the summit in no time! Hit 'Shift' to use your super speed boost!

data.name: Sword of the Bright Knight
data.description: For the strong, for the weak, for justice! This sword has multiple attack modes and does 20 damage points per lunge.

data.name: Star Creaeggtor Cannon 9001
data.description: Don't shoot this cannon at 3 AM! (what happens next will shock you!) Find you favorite video star creator and earn this exclusive egg!

data.name: Halloween Fireworks
data.description: Launches 14 fireworks one by one for quite a Halloween show!

data.name: Presidential Vampire Slaying Ax
data.description: It's what the founding father's would want you to slay vampires with.

data.name: Cursed Mummy Friend
data.description: He's normal just like you and me. Except for that whole mummy curse thing. That's whack.

data.name: April Showers
data.description: I'm told they bring May flowers... or was it they may bring flowers?

data.name: Knights of Redcliff: Battle Axe
data.description: When Redcliff Knights are proficient with the battle axe, their knight masters know they are ready for the next deadly challenge.

data.name: Fancy Skateboard
data.description: Who says skaters are slackers?  Not us!

data.name: Merely's Bluesteel Hoverboard
data.description: Merely is basically the Tony Hawk of hoverboarding.

data.name: Atomblaster 777
data.description: Send your enemies flying with an invisible blast of air!

data.name: Pirate Hook
data.description: Arrr! I be hooked on this weapon!

data.name: Flaming Staff of the Nefarious Red Wizard
data.description: Acts like a flamethrower; click and hold to shoot flames in the direction of your cursor. Part of the nefarious red wizard package!

data.name: Hypobike
data.description: Organically powered awesome bicycle. Travel at regular speed and leave a trail of burning light behind you.

data.name: ROBLOX Winter Games 2014 Bronze Trophy
data.description:
Awarded to the lower scoring levels for earnest effort across all the
Winter Games, as indicated on the Winter Lodge Leaderboard.

data.name: Pepperoni Pizza
data.description: Nom nom nom.  Pizza = delicious.

data.name: Ego Expander 2400
data.description: He's got a big ego.  In fact, it may be so big that his head explodes!

data.name: Illuminating Spear of Revengeance
data.description: There are people who will tell you that revengeance is not a thing, but those are people have never felt the way you do.... or they own dictionaries. Revengeance is yours with this spear that both stabs and charges up for a super powerful attack.

data.name: Telamax xTreme Dual Shoulder Cannons
data.description: When one is not enough

data.name: Wizards of the Astral Isles: Frog Transformer
data.description: Transform those around you into frogs. They'll be forced to hop around and drop all of their weapons!

data.name: 7723 Companion
data.description: Don’t let robots scare you, 7723 is found to be quite a charm. Tune into Netflix’s Next Gen on September 7 to find out more!

data.name: Wizards of the Astral Isles: Limb Stretching Spell
data.description: Use this ancient script to make your arms ridiculously long.  Then hit people with them!

data.name: Opened Bluesteel Basket of Spiky Pwnage
data.description: Nothing beats the feel of genuine bluesteel! Inside you find... Bluesteel Horns of Pwnage.

data.name: Spec Zeta Biograft Energy Sword
data.description: After the tremendous success of the Epsilon sword, only one person was left who understood how to make energy swords.  This is largely due to the scientists testing the swords on one another in an effort to create the best product possible (and to keep all the profit for themselves).  The last scientist left standing created only 200 of these before he was spawn killed by a noob holding his own sword.

data.name: Lepremon
data.description: Trollamon's favorite Leprechaun friend is here to throw exploding gold at anyone silly enough to try and come near you.

data.name: Skeleton Scythe
data.description: Swing at your enemies to do 20 damage per hit.  Press "E" three times to summon a small army.

data.name: Redcliff Wings
data.description: Soar above your foes on the wings of the Redcliff!

data.name: Pot O’ Gold Sword
data.description: Defend your treasure with this mighty sword, leaving a rainbow trail in your wake.

data.name: Basketball
data.description: Dribble the ball and pass it to your friends!

data.name: Alpaca Mount
data.description: Alpaca your bags, you're ready to ride! Equip to spawn in front of you and simply hop on. Walks at a normal pace; however can jump super high.

data.name: Zombification Injection
data.description: Steal other people's life force to transform yourself into a powerful and angry zombie.  As a zombie, use your powerful hammer to do 40 damage per hit to other players.

data.name: Loyal Pizza Warrior Circular Sword
data.description: Part of the Loyal Pizza Warrior package.

data.name: Cupcake Launcher
data.description: I personally think that most cupcakes are too delicious to be launching at people's faces, but I can understand that some people disagree.

data.name: Clown Bomb
data.description: Your enemies will explode with laughter.  Okay maybe they'll just laugh a lot.

data.name: Menacing Mage Energy Ball
data.description: Click to cast the ball of engergy out of your hand, floating around, following you.  Throw it towards your foes and deal 10 damage per hit.  Let it gain power before clicking and it can do up to 75 damage. Part of the menacing mage package.

data.name: Cartoon Network Skateboard
data.description: Shred into summer with this cool Cartoon Network skateboard! Are you CN what we’re sayin’?

data.name: Blow Dryer
data.description: Point and hold down the left mouse button to unleash a stream of hot air that will blow the competition away (quite literally).

data.name: TheAmazeman's ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: TheAmazeman. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Giant Ninja Star
data.description: It’s much more efficient to throw one giant star, rather than a lot of little ones. Click to pull the mighty star off your back and hurl at your foes.

data.name: Bad Luck Sword
data.description: Bad luck for your enemies - good luck for you!  Strike at your foes with this bad luck sword and in addition to regular damage your foe has a 10% chance of being poisoned with one of four different poisons.

data.name: Future Crossbow
data.description: Why are we using a primitive weapon like crossbows in the future? Sometimes to go forward, you have to look backward. And they look really cool.

data.name: Dual Monster Axes
data.description: Sling these at your foes to do some major damage! You'll do 12 to 17 damage when you slash you foes and 25 points on double slash!

data.name: Orinthian Sword and Shield
data.description: Slash enemies with your futuristic sword or stop them dead in their tracks with a shield bash!  Activate the shield bash stun with a right click to stun enemies for 2 seconds.  When enemies are stunned, you can do extra damage!

data.name: Overseer Mage Staff
data.description:
The eye that sees the past, present, and future.
Use it to throw terrible flames at your foes.

data.name: The Dinoboard
data.description: Ride into the Bloxgiving festivities in style on this awesome board. Not only good for transport but also for showing off how cool dinosaurs are!

data.name: Coffee Cruiser
data.description: When you need coffee, make it come to you! Drive around using 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', or the arrow keys. Hit 'X' to toggle the headlight and 'H' to honk. Click with your mouse to fuel up on coffee yourself so you can keep cruising!

data.name: Opened Pastel Basket of Danger
data.description: If danger comes, you will be ready. Inside you find... Springtime Swordpack.

data.name: Knights of Redcliff: Morning Star
data.description: The Redcliffs victory over the Sorcutrolls is widely attributed to the use of the Morning Star.  The Redcliff Morning Star can break body joints and we all know that when a head joint is broken - it's an instant game over.

data.name: Illumina
data.description: Telamon's favorite weapon from Sword Fight on the Heights. It is light, agile, and deadly.

data.name: Magical Turkey Wand
data.description: Turn your enemies into the turkeys that they are!

data.name: Attack Honey Badger
data.description: Honey Badger don't care.  Your honey badger friend will attack the foes you click on.  Then he'll return to faithfully follow you around.

data.name: All-Seeing Golem's Hammer
data.description: Click to swing and deal 15 damage per hit. Double click to do a powerful hammer slam which will create a massive shockwave.

data.name: Nickelodeon Slime Blaster
data.description: Shoot slime at friends and foes with this awesome Slime Launcher. Catch the Kids’ Choice Awards on Nickelodeon, Saturday, March 12th at 8pm/7c!

data.name: Chameleon Potion
data.description: No it's not a karma chameleon - and thank goodness for that!  This will transform your appearance to be like whatever you click.  Now you see me... now you think I'm a grey baseboard.

data.name: Marching Drum
data.description: Rhythm is everywhere! Click to let out a radical drum roll, and build tension.

data.name: Snow Knight Lance
data.description: Click to jab this at your enemies! Rapidly click to rapidly jab, hitting the enemy more and dealing more damage. Does roughly 15 damage per hit. Part of the Snow Knight's package.

data.name: Captain America's Civil War Shield
data.description: Vibranium Shield used by Captain America in his fight for justice! After you claim your prize be sure to check out Captain America: Civil War on May 6th!

data.name: Pencil Sword
data.description: Look out, I'm gonna rub you out!

data.name: Video Star Pizza Launcher
data.description: What's better than having your pizza delivered?  Having your favorite YouTuber launch it at you with a special prize.

data.name: Snow Fiend's Daggers
data.description: The Snow Fiend dual wields these daggers.  Throw them individually and together. Each dagger does 20 damage.  Part of the Snow Fiend package.

data.name: Airstrike
data.description: Your foes don't stand a chance when you call your pilot friends for reinforcements!  Use this to call a jet fighter that launches missiles at any area you designate.

data.name: Porter's Pumpkin Pitchfork
data.description: Whether posing for a rural portrait, shoveling some hay, or eating the biggest salad ever made, this gothic pitchfork is perfect for when normal forks just aren’t big enough (or if your spoon is already too big). Also works very well for fending off all those things that go bump in the night.

data.name: Christmas Tree Launcher
data.description: Launch miniature Christmas trees, and watch as they instantly become full size!

data.name: Omega Rainbow Sword
data.description: The power of all future rainbows is at your finger tips. Click to slash, dealing 18 to 22 damage per hit. Double click to dash forward with the speed of a magical rainbow!

data.name: Monster Attack
data.description: Grow fiery horns and charge at your foes.

data.name: Grapple Hook
data.description: Seize the day (and pretty much anything else you want to seize) with this grappling gun.

data.name: Throwing Knife Pen
data.description: You look like you're about to sign this contract to give away the coveted magical super weapon, but no! You are a secret agent who has a knife disguised as a pen!  Click to remove the cap and then slash all the foes. Click and hold to charge the force of the throw when you release the knife from your hand. A hit will do 40 damage.  The secret weapon is safe... for now.

data.name: Attack Koala
data.description: Oh he's a grumpy little guy. Faithfully follows you and unloads his frustrations on your foes.

data.name: Korblox: Berserker's Claymore
data.description:
Crafted using their corrupted magic, this claymore is as deadly as it is heavy. Handed down from generation to generation to the mightiest Korbloxian warriors, this legendary weapon was once wielded by Canavus himself. 

With its ability to double its strength in the blink of an eye, this weapon outmatches almost all weapons at close range. Only the mighty knight Xargas is said to have be able to hold his own against this claymore!

data.name: Treacherous Throwing Knives
data.description: Dagger, dagger, dagger! Made for throwing only, click to launch three daggers at your foes.

data.name: Light Face Melting Guitar
data.description: That heavenly sound that will bring the house (and people's faces) down.

data.name: Boss Bunny Bow and Arrow
data.description: The boss bunny is the boss for a reason.  Boss bunny never misses a shot. Use his bow and arrow to fire arrows that do 35 damage per hit.

data.name: Frozen Blue Ice Crossbow
data.description: Fire ice cold arrows at your foes, which will occasionally freeze them upon hit. Each hit does 20 damage.

data.name: Fruity Pebbles Power Up
data.description: This is advertising. Yet also delicious. In fact, so delicious that if you use it in game you will find yourself jumping to new heights

data.name: Ghost Minion
data.description: Heals you until you are more powerful than you ever were (150 hp).  But don't worry, if you die - he will avenge you!

data.name: Trident

data.name: Black Hole Sword

data.name: Tri-Laser 333

data.name: Overseer's Steed

The Spec X program had been accelerated in the late 2120s as the prospect of an all out metahuman vs. machine war became increasingly likely. Prized for their ability to slice through viridian steel exoskeletons, the US was determined to find a substitute for the pure diamond required for the manufacture of the Beta models. Sapphire, while still exorbitantly expensive, allowed the army to produce blades that were 95% as effective as the Betas, at only 20% the cost.

On behalf of everyone at ROBLOX, thank you for participating in the 2017 Egg Hunt! 

Here comes the boom.

If you max out the boiler pressure, the bow will instead fire three pieces of rebar in a fan-shaped pattern. No matter how many projectiles you fire, their speed is determined by the amount of pressure in the system.
