data.name: Korblox - Fallen's Spine Blade
data.description: In the heat of battle, when the weapon fails him, a true Korblox warrior is not afraid of ripping his spine apart and slashing through his adversaries.

data.name: Box Of Chocolates
data.description: Life is like a box of chocolates - you never know what you're gonna get.  I'm hoping for super speed.

data.name: Ninja Jump Potion
data.description: Do some sweet ninja jumping with this ninja potion!

data.name: Protest Sign: Pro Fake Mustache
data.description: It's a reasonable position, I think.

data.name: 8-Bit Sword and Shield
data.description: It can be dangerous if you go it alone, you'd better take this.

data.name: Sir Kitty McPawnington's Sword and Sheild
data.description: Slash, slash, scratch your enemies to deal 25 damage. Press and hold the 'Q' key to block. This slows you down, though it doubles your health. By clicking, you can whack your enemies with the shield. This does 30 to 40 damage. If you successfully hit someone with the shield, a cat screech sound plays. Part of the Sir Kitty McPawnington's Package.

data.name: Chocolate Gelt
data.description: Who knew money could be so yummy!

data.name: Redcliff Crossbow
data.description: Fire arrows at all that would dare cross the mighty Redcliff. Each hit will do epic damage.

data.name: Polar Warrior's Spear
data.description: Click to lunge this spear at your enemies; dealing roughly 20 damage per hit.  Part of the Polar Warrior's package.

data.name: Potato Cannon
data.description: Cloudy with a chance of raw potatoes? Hurl potatoes through the sky to stun your foes!

data.name: Volleyball
data.description: Get ready for the longest volleyball rally of all time!

data.name: Sparkle Time Lump of Coal
data.description: We told you it was unlucky!  This item came out of the unluckiest gift on December 16th, 2013.

data.name: Rockin' Pink Guitar
data.description: Rock on! Use the keys 'Z', 'X', 'C', 'V', 'B', 'N', 'M', to play different chords. You can play sharp version of the notes by holding shift. You can alter the pitch as well with the keys 'G', 'H', 'J', 'K', 'L'.

data.name: Legendary Ice Club
data.description: This Ice Club is part of the Legendary Yeti package.

data.name: Knights of the Splintered Skies: Sword
data.description: Strike at your foes and in addition to doing damage you will push them to the ground.

data.name: Blue Bloxxers Paintball Gun
data.description: Get ready for the bloxxing of a lifetime!

data.name: The Adventures of Noob Boy: Part 1
data.description: Help save the noob from the angry green circles! Use A and D to move left and right, and W to jump. This is the first 2D platformer we have released in a gear, so come be a part of Robloxian history!  Get it for free when you redeem a Gamestop card in June 2011!

data.name: Military Dress Sword
data.description: Sword of honor, sword of might, strike the right foe tonight.  This sword slashes and lunges.  For a special attack press 'W' twice before striking.

data.name: Attack Sloth
data.description: He just wants a hug...a real slow one...Does 5 damage and slows down your opponents!

data.name: Hiro the Hero Dual Swords
data.description: Part of the Hiro the Hero package. A set of dual swords.Click to equip. Double click to dash on green fire while double slashing in front of you. Slashing does 14 to 18 damage; double slashing does 18 to 26 damage.

data.name: The Tormentor's Axe
data.description: Only the very best escape the hot steel of the Tormentor's Axe!

data.name: CJJ’s Guide to Making Money
data.description: Can Charlie Joe make some extra cash doing as little work as possible? Find out in Charlie Joe Jackson’s Guide to Making Money. Start reading now!

data.name: Wooden Club
data.description: Cavemen used these to hunt their prey. I'm pretty sure they needed a bigger one for the woolly mammoths.

data.name: Snowflake Shield and Sword
data.description: Take up arms against the frozen winter wind!

data.name: Golden Football
data.description: Celebrate NFL’s centennial season with a 24-karat pigskin, perfect for completing your winning ensemble.

data.name: Mr. Whiskers
data.description: A faithful feline friend to the end. Toss his favorite skeleton fish and he'll fetch it back.  When not fetching; he follows you around the map like a loyal pet.

data.name: Golden Bloxxer
data.description: So many KOs, so little time.  This trophy was awarded to the ultimate bloxxers of 2014. Three cheers for the golden bloxxers!  This item will be awarded to the top 1000 competitors in the 2014 Clan Battle Arenas.

data.name: Opened Sparkle Basket of Bunny Time
data.description: Bunny Basket of Sparkle Time?  You should always take time to sparkle and shine.  Inside you find... Sparkle Time Bunny Ears.

data.name: Snow and Arrow
data.description: Click and hold to pull the arrow back further, charging it and increasing its damage. Minimum damage is 5, and maximum is 66.

data.name: 2019 Fireworks
data.description: Start off 2019 with a bang!

data.name: 2013 Trick or Treat Bag
data.description: Trick or treat. Choice is yours. Makes your character 35% faster. Is allowed in Halloween 2013 game to run faster and collect BLOXikins!

data.name: Body Swap Potion
data.description: Ever wanted to see what it was like to live as someone else?  Wonder no more!

data.name: ROBLOX Frisbee
data.description: Whether you play Ultimate or old school - this is the frisbee for you!

data.name: Builderman's Hammer of Shimmering Light
data.description:
Better to light one small candle  
than to curse the darkness.

data.name: Gold Eagle Sword
data.description: A very stylish and patriotic sword, which you can run around with, making a red, white, and blue striped trail behind your character! Slash at your enemies, dealing about 20 damage per hit. If you blox someone with this an eagle swoops down from the sky and grabs your enemy and flies him away!

data.name: Wraith's Screech Potion
data.description: His scream pierces all that come near him.

data.name: Zombie Penguin Attack Horde
data.description: A horde of six zombie penguins! When an enemy is nearby, they'll slide on their bellies over to the enemy, then stand up with their wings out (in traditional zombie fashion) and attack the enemy!

data.name: Millennium Falcon
data.description: Explore the realms of Roblox with Han Solo’s ship! Be sure to watch Solo: A Star Wars Story, in theaters May 25!

data.name: Snow Wolf Companion
data.description: A great companion is always by your side, even in the coldest weather.

data.name: Racing Tractor
data.description: He traded tilling fields for chasing thrills!

data.name: Knife of lolololeris
data.description:
It’s loleris’s knife and it’s sharp! Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Vanishing Ninja Star
data.description: "Your foes won't even know what hit 'em. They won't even see it coming." - Stickmasterluke

data.name: Bunneh Blade
data.description: This sword will make you fast as a hasty hare and double your walk speed.  The speed boost makes it easy to catch up to your foes and use the slash or upper-cut attacks.

data.name: Mahem's ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: Mahem. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Christmas Tree Lights
data.description: My mom likes the little white ones. But everyone knows big clunky colored lights are best! Comes in 7 or 8 colors! Shoot them at a Christmas tree to decorate it!

data.name: Skeleton Slashers
data.description: Click to slash, dealing between 15 to 25 damage. Double click to dash forward and double-slash, using both arms. If you can hit your opponent with this attack, they take 30 points of damage!

data.name: The Unstoppable
data.description: What happens when the Unstoppable object meets an unyielding force?

data.name: Bat Sword
data.description: na na na na na na na na BAT SWORD!

data.name: Bouquet of Pain Throwing Stars
data.description: The only thing more painful than spring allergies: flower shaped throwing stars.

data.name: Homemade Sword and Shield
data.description: This mighty homemade sword and shield set is perfect for any warrior.  The sword does 9-12 damage per hit. The mighty shield is activated when you press 'q'. This epic cardboard shield doubles your health and cuts down enemy damage by 50%.

data.name: RDC 2017 Builder's Trophy
data.description: This exclusive trophy was awarded to the top winners of Roblox’s prestigious building competition, which took place during the RDC 2017 Game Jam.

data.name: Gold Microphone
data.description:
You can't do a mic drop unless you pick one up first. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Throwing Bolts
data.description: Being struck by lightning is a shocking experience.

data.name: Earth's Might Staff
data.description: Summon a heavy boulder to drop on your enemies.  If you click and hold, the boulder will gain more force!

data.name: Spam Cannon
data.description: Shoot spam at your friends! Includes such classics as - "donate plox" and "post this on ten items and get on free"

data.name: The Duke's Blade of Due Process
data.description: Swift justice. Cuts through red tape like no one’s business.

data.name: Larry’s Night Guard Flashlight
data.description: The Museum comes alive at night! Use Larry’s flashlight to guide your way to the next level and into theaters to see Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb on December 19th!

data.name: Korblox Skeleton Wraith
data.description: He was alive when they put him in the box!  Now he's your official Korblox guardian pet.  The Korblox Skeleton Wraith came out of the Gift of the Korbloxian on October 26th, 2012

data.name: Time Watch
data.description: What time is it?  You decide!

data.name: TheGamer101's ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: TheGamer101. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Korblox: Tripmine
data.description: These ghastly mines were invented by the Korbloxians to trap anyone and everyone brave enough to ever venture out into the wilds.

data.name: Bongos
data.description: Dance to the rhythm of the beat!

data.name: Call Me Cellphone
data.description: It's not a request.

data.name: Vuvuzela
data.description: Annoy soccer player, soccer fans, or pretty much anyone else with this Vuvuzela.

data.name: Bacon Launcher
data.description: Equip this awesome bacon launcher to start cooking that sizzling bacon. Click to fire bacon at your foes.

data.name: Ninja Star Launcher
data.description: Your foes will just be seeing stars. They’ll never know what hit them.

data.name: Overseer Short Sword
data.description: Ready to do some serious damage? Hit 'Q' to summon 5 Overseer minions to do your bidding for up to two minutes.

data.name: Woodland Archer Bow
data.description: Part of the Woodland Archer package!

data.name: Gigantic Bat Wings
data.description: On leathery wings, you rule the night. Click to take flight and own the sky, using the 'W' 'A' 'S' and 'D' keys to move around.

data.name: Hiccup the Dragon Rider
data.description: Hero of Berk, the original dragon rider, and champion of humans and dragons alike. That is a pretty solid résumé for a companion.

data.name: Seahorse
data.description: Celebrate World Ocean Day by riding a giant seahorse!

data.name: Knights of Redcliff: Sword and Shield
data.description: Second only to the infamous Redcliff Archers, the Redcliff Knights who wield the sword and shield, are fast and efficient.  They see their target, and they take him out in 5 swipes or less.

data.name: Ne'Kotikoz Phaser
data.description: The Ne'Kotikoz will ask you to move politely, then they'll pull out the Phasers.  Trust me, you don't want them to pull out the Phasers.

data.name: Sword of Nefertiti
data.description: Wrath of the gods. And those ancient Egyptian gods were pretty wrathful.

data.name: Dance Grenade
data.description: The roof, the roof, the roof is on fire!  The roof is on fire because you just set off this awesome dance grenade!

data.name: Retro Super Villain Laser Gun
data.description: This is what villains of the past thought laser guns would look like in the future. Shoot turquoise green beams at your foes to do 20 damage per hit. If you've got more time, you can click and hold to charge and do up to 65 damage per hit!

data.name: Hades Staff of Darkness - A Gamestop Exclusive
data.description: Imagine a world where no one can see what's coming but you....

data.name: 26th Century Weapon
data.description: A elegant weapon from the future of the past...

data.name: Ameriboard
data.description: Skateboarding for freedom since 1776!  Okay maybe not quite that long...

data.name: Laser Electrocutor
data.description: Don't laser electrocute me bro!

data.name: Staff of the Woodlands
data.description: Druids of the Great Forest use the mystical powers of this wooden staff to camouflage themselves as they travel through the hinterlands. Use of this staff renders your character difficult to see for a short while.

data.name: Haunted Armor Sword
data.description: One touch and all the power is yours, along with all its drawbacks...Part of the Haunted Armor Bundle.

data.name: ROBLOX Invisicar
data.description: The Admin-engineered ROBLOX Invisicar - moving ROBLOXians forward since... earlier today.

data.name: All-Seeing Sentry
data.description: These sentries see your enemies so you don't have to!

data.name: Earth Protection Orb
data.description: Heal the world!  In ROBLOX - world heals you!  Well...it at least protects you!  This Earth orbits around you and shields you from nearby foes. Anyone who dares approach you will feel the burning wrath of core magma!

data.name: Zombie Attack Bunny
data.description: You're nobody till somebunny bites you. Summon a zombie bunny by your side that will hop after and attack enemy that gets too close. He's loyal and will walk wherever you click nearby and attack anybody you wish!

data.name: Witch Wand
data.description: She turned me into a newt, she did!

data.name: Santa's Sleigh
data.description: Soar above the sky in Santa's magical flying sleigh.  Try not to drop too many presents accidentally!

data.name: Viridian Katana
data.description: Sometimes it is easy being green.  Easy to slash through foes, easy to win the battle, easy to win the war.

data.name: HEX Spitter
data.description: A genuine Hex style laser blaster- shoot lightning lasers at lightning fast rates.

data.name: Gravity Gun
data.description: Try out the new gravity gun and make the Spacetime fabric look like your grandma’s knitted sweaters. Aim this at an object to levitate it for a short amount of time.

data.name: Snake Sniper
data.description: Shoot snakes from a snake. Your foes will never see it coming... okay they might.  You are shooting a snake from a snake after all.

data.name: Opened Basket of Musical Domination
data.description: Get Rex! Inside you find... Musica Rex Dominator.

data.name: Dual Bacon Daggers
data.description: Bacon goes with everything! Even daggers.  Click to swing one of your daggers at your foe and do 15 damage. Double click to do a special bacon attack which does 20 damage.  Wear the bacon crown while using these daggers to do an additional 15 damage.

data.name: Presidential Salute
data.description: Fireworks are a nonpartisan issue.

data.name: Lightning Orb
data.description: Summon lightning to stun your enemies!

data.name: Frozen Halberd
data.description: A trail of ice follows the halberd's blade as you swing furiously at your enemy. A hit will set the other player on fire and does 40 damage, and encases your foe in ice.

data.name: Springtime Cutlass Of Infinite Virtue
data.description: The Prince of Infinite Virtue is in trouble and only you can save him from the evil that surrounds.  Duty calls!

data.name: Electric Blue
data.description: For rockers with soulful lyrics.

data.name: Dynamically Lit Sword
data.description: Darkness strikes in the light!  Swing your glowing sword at your foes to do 25 damage per hit.

data.name: Ghost Dragon
data.description: Let the Ghost Dragon do your bidding!  Flies above you and sends out 100 points of damage on your behalf.

data.name: Crystal Sphere Drop
data.description: Icosahedral geodesic sphere to be exact. Launch this flagpole at your foes and then wait for the ball to drop.  5.4.3.2.1

data.name: Igloo of Solitude
data.description: It's not quite a Fortress of Solitude, but, then again, you're not quite Superman, are you?

data.name: Golden Magic Carpet
data.description: Ride your own golden carpet through the skies of Roblox! Use the 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' or arrow keys to control the direction. A magical golden trail will track your path through the sky.

data.name: Jingle Bells
data.description: Remember, Jingle Bells are not for hitting.

data.name: Rock It Guitar
data.description: We're going to party like it's 19999!

data.name: Cobra Star
data.description: If the blades don't get you... the snakes will!

data.name: Midnight Motorcycle
data.description: Use 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', or the arrow keys to control this maniac of a motorcycle.

data.name: Toothless
data.description: Get Toothless, Hiccup’s best friend and the only known Night Fury, from DreamWork’s Dragons: Race to the Edge.

data.name: Knights of the Splintered Skies: Ballista
data.description: While their capability to melee combat their opponents is only rivaled by the RedCliff Knights, the Knights of the Splintered Skies also make use of some heavy artillery. The ballista, a strong long range powerful artillery, is capable of shooting bolts at ridiculous speed and power, and destroying multiple targets at once. With its hidden ability to fire lit bolts that do constant light damage, the ballista is a powerful weapon indeed.

data.name: Zoom Broom 5000
data.description: The fastest broom on the market, be sure to hold on tight! Equip and click and drag to fly around in the direction of your cursor.

data.name: Starblox Latte
data.description: Drinking a Starblox Latte is a great way to add a little speed to your step - but if you drink too many your head might explode.

data.name: Apple Pie
data.description: I know banana cream is the traditional comedy throwing pie. I know that. But people don't eat banana cream pie for Thanksgiving, unless they work in a comedy factory and get them for free. Careful, the apples are hot!

data.name: Captain's Flintlock
data.description: This flintlock is slightly more accurate than the average pirate's flintlock.  It's gold plated so the captain knows if any of the other pirates try to switch flintlocks with him while he's sleeping.

data.name: Wild Bunny Horde Attack
data.description: When bunnies attack- the true ROBLOX story.  Deploy your attack bunny and he will summon all his bunny clan to fight on your behalf.   After you deploy the bunny holes spawn and bunnies pop up to follow your commands.

data.name: Spec Beta Biograft Energy Sword
data.description: In 2113, decades after the initial release of the hugely successful Spec Alpha biograft energy weapons, the US government began research on a top-secret upgrade. The breakthrough was to use artificial diamonds to forge the blade itself, rather that carbon nanofibers. The new weapon was very effective, but obscenely expensive. Only a hundred were ever made.

data.name: Golden Rolling Hoverboard
data.description: Nothing says sophistication like solid gold. Control your direction using arrow keys or the 'W', 'A', 'S', and 'D' keys. Hit Backspace to dismount.

data.name: Anti-Vampire Stake
data.description: When you invite a vampire over for a "stake" dinner, I don't think they'll appreciate the joke. Lunge at vicious vampires for 20 damage.

data.name: Fencing Foil
data.description: En garde! This sword is very quick. It does high lunging damage but very low slashing damage.

data.name: EMP Shockmine
data.description: Shock the gear out of your opponents hands.

data.name: Knights of the Splintered Skies: Morning Star
data.description: Just like their fellow Knights of the RedCliff, the Knights of the Splintered Skies are famous for their mastery with the Morning Star, but a lighter and faster version of it. Beware, as this one can break some heads!

data.name: Orinthian Electroslasher
data.description: Click to slash, dealing 16 to 20 damage. Hit the 'Q' key to spawn three Orinthian warrior minions in front of you, which will chase nearby enemies, dealing 10 damage per hit.

data.name: Zombie Hunter Motorcycle
data.description: I came here to fight zombies and drink Bloxy cola, and I just finished my can.

data.name: Laser Gun of Tomorrow
data.description: Click to fire a burst of 5 neon teal colored lasers! Each do 8 damage. If all 5 hit their target, that's a total of 40 damage!

data.name: Will Wilder Book
data.description: In this supernatural thriller, a 12-year-old’s quest to uncover his family’s secret past puts everyone he knows in danger.

data.name: Beach Ball
data.description: Have a ball with this classic beach toy.

data.name: Penguin Potion
data.description: Waddle like a pro!

data.name: Native Bow and Arrow
data.description: Fire one arrow or maybe five!

data.name: First Aid Kit
data.description: It was hard, but you graduated college with a 4.2 GPA and got into a decent med school. Then you slogged through 4 more years of memorizing random facts. THEN you slaved away through 4 years of residency. THEN you got drafted by the army and make $45,000 a year. NOW you run around like mad, flinging medkits at your team mates just trying not to get shot. Yes. Law school was the right choice. You owned yourself.

data.name: Hula Dog
data.description: He thinks it's always Aloha Friday.

data.name: The Seventh Snake Spell
data.description: You gotta loosen your tongue for this and be prepared to spit a lot! Click to summon snakes who will do your bidding.

data.name: Super Speedy Pink Potion
data.description:
It's the right mix of chemicals and the right shade to make a statement. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Rainbow Hot Air Balloon
data.description: This is advertising. And the stars look very different today. Here I am floating round my Hot Air Balloon – far above the spoon (for my cereal).

data.name: Civil War Artillery
data.description: Equip and click this gear to drop a real live cannon in front of you.  Control the cannons direction with the 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' keys - lift and lower it with the cannon with the 'Q' and 'E' keys.  When you've got your shot set up - sit on the cannon and click! Hitting the 'X' key will remove it from the map.

data.name: Ne'Kotikoz Incarnate
data.description: Trade places with your intergalactic friend (or perhaps fiend?) and shoot fireballs at your enemies.

data.name: Elven Blade of Glory
data.description: Rumored to bring glory to all who fight with it, the Elven Blade of Glory assures you a victory against even the toughest of opponents.

data.name: Jungle Guitar
data.description: Great for jamming in the jungle or making rhythms in the rainforest.

data.name: Toxic Goo Trap
data.description: Encase your enemies in toxic goo for fun and profit!  Okay maybe just fun.

data.name: Epicsauce
data.description: Ultimate EPIC Juice Brand Epicsauce. Extremely hot.

data.name: Black Iron Katana
data.description: Slash and lunge at your foes with this amazing katana to do 12 to 16 points of damage. The power of the blackest iron surrounds this Katana.

data.name: Flying Reindeer
data.description: Fly high in the sky on your very own reindeer! Use 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' or the arrow keys to control the direction of flight.

data.name: The Unicorn Mace
data.description: This mace is known for dolling out punishment and a great way to fight fire with fire. Now hold tight, it ain’t over till it’s over.

data.name: Wall Walker
data.description: I wish I could summon my own personal anywhere elevator in real life... Uphill is my least favorite direction

data.name: Chaos Master's Wing Slasher
data.description: Man may not fly in your presence.  Any person with wings will have them slashed by this sword and fall to their peril.  As for your enemies on the ground, they'll have a tough time escaping this swords speedy 24 damage hit.

data.name: Red Convertible
data.description: Zip around the streets of ROBLOX in your sweet red convertible. Let the virtual wind flow through your virtual hair and feel the joy of summer!

data.name: Sun Slayer Sword
data.description: The chosen weapon of the Sun Slayer. Each swing strikes true and swift.

data.name: Splinter's Staff
data.description: Master Splinter is the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles’ Sensei, teaching them how to fight and protect their home. Unlock his character in TMNT: Turtle Trouble and win his staff!

data.name: Exploding Pumpkins
data.description: Extremely festive and extremely dangerous to your foes. Click to deploy the bomb; it deals 60 damage, splitting up and multiplying into a bunch of smaller bombs.

data.name: Protest Sign: We Want User GUIs Now!
data.description: User GUIs will revolutionize ROBLOX and we don't want to wait another single day before we can play with them. If you don't agree, we will beat you into submission with rational pro/con discussions, so you might as well give us what we want right now.

data.name: Wasp Wings
data.description: Equip this item and get wasp wings that give you speed, and more importantly the ability to charge your enemies with a deadly wasp dash.  Any hit while in wasp dash mode does 80 damage on impact!

data.name: Inflatable Saxophone
data.description: Play some airy tunes with this sax.

data.name: Year of the Dragon Lantern
data.description: Light the lantern to invoke the protection of the ancient dragon spirits.  If anyone is foolish enough to attack you while you are surrounded by dragon spirits, well then maybe they get what they deserve.

data.name: Hungry Lion Friend
data.description: He's hungry, but he's also your friend.  So he probably won't eat you.... probably.

data.name: Robot Dance Gun
data.description: Laser gun that compels anyone it hits to do the robot!

data.name: High Five
data.description: I've got a high five with your name on it! Only if your name is 5...

data.name: Bunny Moto
data.description: Gotta go fast like a bunny! Control using 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', or arrow keys. Hit space to leap up (like a bunny) with this motorcycle.

data.name: Redcliff Battleaxe
data.description: When evil looms, Redcliff Knights answer the call, with this might axe! Click to slash enemies, unleash a mighty lunge attack to do more damage.

data.name: Darkest Arts Sword
data.description: A dark magic possesses this sword. Use it as a sword or use its dark magic to destroy the artifacts of others.

data.name: Moneybag
data.description: Rich people like to carry these around and shake them, leaving a trail of money behind them.

data.name: Knights of RedCliff: Battle Horn
data.description: Blow thy horn and blast thy foes as the noble RedCliff Eagles swarm unto the battlefield doing justice to thy goals.

data.name: Cymbals
data.description: Clash!  Slam these babies together to make a loud sound!  Does no damage.

data.name: Vine Staff
data.description: Creates a wall of vines around your character. Anyone attempting to get through the vines tends to get stuck.

data.name: Captain Snowbeard's Flintlock
data.description: Shoot snowballs at your enemies! Upon impact, the snowball will burst into a bunch of pieces of snow and scatter around the area it hit. Anyone hit is dealt 8 damage, and snow obscures their vision by covering their screen temporarily! This item is part of the Captain Snowbeard package.

data.name: Red Carpet Hoverboard
data.description: Now you can hover in style!

data.name: Hot Wheels Gold Car
data.description: The Hot Wheels Gold car. The number one model for speed, power and performance. 0-60 in 5.4 seconds. Power: 520. Lap Time 1:20:5. Coolness: 10/10

data.name: The Specialist's grenade
data.description: Click and hold to have a chargeable bar appear on your screen. It'll quickly rise and lower. The closer the bar is to being full, the further you can throw the grenade. Let go of your mouse button when it's within a reasonable range of where your target lies. Be careful though - you can also be damaged by this grenade, which does 60 damage.

data.name: Confetti Cannon
data.description: Shoot pure joy at your friends!

data.name: Roman Catapult
data.description: Equip this catapult and click to spawn a giant catapult in front of you.  Click again to add a flaming brick to the catapult and watch it launch in any direction you point your mouse!  As it travels through the air it increases in size and will do 35 points of damage to anyone it hits.

data.name: Red Sparkle Time Claymore
data.description: Slash fiercely at your enemies with vengeance, dealing some massive damage; between 15 to 35 points.  Click and hold for 3 seconds to summon a red ring of enchantment that shoots rubies up around you and does 12.5 points of damage to anyone they hit.

data.name: Soccer Ball
data.description: Perfect for kicking around with friends or a real match.

data.name: Goblet
data.description: Thirsty?

data.name: Amerisword
data.description: Fighting for freedom everyday!

data.name: Golden Katana of the Unflinching Dawn
data.description: "Victory is reserved for those who are willing to pay it's price." - Sun Tzu

data.name: Horde of Attack Chirps
data.description: Don't let their cute eyes fool you, they're deadly. Summon a horde of chirps to your side. Click on a foe to launch a chirp attack!

data.name: Discus 2012
data.description: Throw this discus far enough and you'll get an explosive reward.

data.name: Knights of Redcliff: Deluxe Sword and Shield Set
data.description: Don't let this simple, elegant blade fool you.  This is the most deadly Redcliff sword yet!

data.name: Cinco de Mayo Piñata
data.description: Celebrate with this festive piñata!  Drops 1 of 10 surprise items!

data.name: Outrageous Board with a Nail in It
data.description: Did they? That outrageous board with a nail in it may have defeated us. But the humans won't stop there. They'll make bigger boards and bigger nails, and soon, they will make a board with a nail so big, it will destroy them all!

data.name: The Arabian Nights
data.description: "Imagine a thousand thousand fireflies of every shape and color; Oh, that was Baghdad at night in those days."

data.name: Battle Bottle
data.description: This bottle is half full...of explosives.

data.name: Black and White Sword
data.description: Click to double slash your opponents. A successful hit deals 25 damage. Beware a wielder of this sword's jump.  After jumping they will spin around leaving phantom blades that will do 10 damage per hit.

data.name: Festive Laser Blaster
data.description: Jingle bells, jingle bells, blast them all with lasers! Fire red and green projectiles that do five damage per hit.

data.name: Trilaser Bow
data.description: Arrows are so last decade.  Charge and blast powerful lasers from  your bow.  No need for quivers... no need for arrows!

data.name: Unicorn Nunchuks
data.description: Unicorns may be peaceful, but their horns aren’t. Ouch! Click to swing at your foes to deal 18 to 26 points of damage per hit.

data.name: Snowped
data.description: Dashing though the snow is way more fun on this than any old one horse open sleigh.

data.name: The Archon Blade
data.description: Delivering the swift justice of ages gone by.  Get this exclusive blade when you redeem a ROBLOX card from CVS by February 28th.

data.name: Turbo's Speed Shell
data.description: Do you dream of going fast? Grab Turbo's Speed Shell for instant acceleration!

data.name: Aluminium Selfie Stick
data.description:
Because you can't always bother strangers to take your picture. Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: 4th of July 2016 Fireworks
data.description: Ignite the sky with these festive fireworks!

data.name: Homemade Motorcycle
data.description: Look ma, I made my own motorcycle!  Of course it's safe, it's virtual!

data.name: Overseer Spider Mount
data.description: Climb aboard your very own spider. Walk on the ground or climb up walls!

data.name: Sword of Darkness
data.description: Dare to reach out your hand into the darkness, to pull another hand into the dark from the light.

data.name: Golden Bow and Arrow
data.description: This golden bow is stylish and effective.  Click and hold to charge your arrows and increase the damage your arrow does! When you hit your enemy with a fully charged arrow they will turn into solid gold for 15 seconds. Press 'Q' to use the bow as a grappling hook.

data.name: Remote Mine
data.description: Remote Mine activating in 5...4....3...2....BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!

data.name: Rotten Pumpkin Toss
data.description: Click this item to drop this stinky pumpkin.  Anyone who comes near it is overpowered by it's horrifying stench and falls over - unable to move until the smell has disappeared.

data.name: Magmarealm Crossbow
data.description: This ain't your granny's crossbow.

data.name: Crazy Chicken Bow
data.description: Hit your foes with you your crazy chicken arrows. They'll end up with egg on their face and quite a bit of damage.

data.name: RDC First Runner Up 2018 - Silver
data.description: Congratulations on being the First Runner Up at the 2018 RDC Game Jam!

data.name: Quadshooter
data.description: Because sometimes you just have to shoot four things at a time. You can fire four times, three times, before you have to reload!

data.name: Ninja Guitar
data.description: Take time out from your ninja training to rock!

data.name: Red Futurion Blaster
data.description: Part of the Red Futurion Package.

data.name: Lucky Clover
data.description: "I'm lookin' over a four leaf clover" at a rainbow.  What's at the other side of the rainbow?  Only one way to find out!

data.name: Ham Fists
data.description: "Eat the ham, Tina." After you eat the ham, your fists will turn into ham fists - which you can use to punch your foes. Each hit does 15 damage.

data.name: Red Hover Roped
data.description: We dared to ask, "Could a roped hover?" Now we dare to dream, "What if it were red?"

data.name: Go Fish
data.description: Challenge your friends to see who can catch the most fish!

data.name: Knights of the Seventh Sanctum : Dual Duel Axes
data.description: You're dueling.  Your opponent has an axe... but you have two!  Wield the unholy relics of the Seventh Sanctum and no one else stands a chance... unless they have these axes too.  But how likely is that?

data.name: Classic Plane
data.description: You'll go plane crazy for this awesome plane. Jump in and fly around ROBLOXIA.

data.name: Misfortune Cookie
data.description: It's not going to bring you luck but it might be fun.

data.name: Monster Mash Dance Potion
data.description: You'll be a graveyard smash with this thrilling dance potion.

data.name: Mars Mission 1 Blaster
data.description: Part of the Mars Mission 1 Package.   http://www.roblox.com/Mars-Mission-1-item?id=144511523

data.name: Midnight Sword
data.description: Slash at your foes to do 10 damage. Charge the sword by holding down the left mouse button to change day to night, increase your walk speed, and increase the damage your sword does.

data.name: Icicle Slicer - A Gamestop Exclusive
data.description: Icy doom awaits!

data.name: Scythe of Singularity
data.description: This mighty weapon will leave you spinning.  Literally.

data.name: Speedy Cleats
data.description: Nice to CLEAT you! Equip this gear to double your speed!

data.name: Bombo's Survival Raig Table
data.description: When Bombo gets mad, he gets really mad, explosively mad!

data.name: Noobcaik
data.description: Throw this to a friend to spam him with noobish comments.  He will be temporarily blinded.

data.name: Magic Bunny
data.description: Magic bunny wants to help you find eggs that are hiding skyscrapers above you.  When you're holding him you jump extraordinarily high!!!

data.name: Combat Mop
data.description: I came here to clean house.

data.name: Rockin' Feline Guitar
data.description: I love every kind of cat. Press 'Z', 'X', 'C', 'V', 'B', 'N' and 'M' to play. When you press 'M', the guitar will make a meow sound.

data.name: Galactic Forcefield Glove
data.description: Charge the glove to blast your enemies!  Foes beware - touching someone while they charge the glove will result in immediate shock!

data.name: Santa's Jolly Jetpack
data.description: Santa's a big guy.  Going down the chimney is easy - getting back up - not so much.  Enter Santa's Jolly Jetpack!

data.name: Magical Umbrella
data.description: Float away with this magical umbrella.  Click to do a twirling trick. Jump while moving to go farther. Click a lot to make it float away! (does not make the player fly)

data.name: Dread Dark Wizard Staff
data.description: Mighty is the hand that holds this dark power. Click to launch deadly reddish orbs at your enemies; dealing 20 damage each! You can fire up to 6 at a time before being hit with a short cooldown. Part of the Dread Dark Wizard package.

data.name: Bloxcon Hall of Fame 2014
data.description: All you do is win!  This trophy is awarded to winners of ROBLOX's 2014 Hall of Fame. Bask in the glory of being one of the community's top builders!

data.name: The Daring Archer's Bow & Arrow
data.description: This bow does damage based on the distance of your strike for a minimum of 15 damage and a maximum of 55. Part of the Daring Archer package.

data.name: Trollamom
data.description: Trollamom is sure to scare your foes with her deadly "mom glare".  You know the look, one that only moms can give where it feels like they're shooting lasers out of their eyes? Well this mom actually shoots lasers.  But that's not all! After her deadly glare, Trollamom summons Trollamon, who will throw pieces of fried chicken at your enemies. Aren't moms great?

data.name: Cavalry Sabre
data.description: You're ready to defend the Wild West with this sabre!

data.name: Andromeda Explorer Power Punch
data.description: Part of the Andromeda Explorer package! These rocket fists fly forward and slam into your foes.

data.name: Jumpin' Jack's Trick And Treat Bag
data.description: As you take damage, your power meter increases. Eat candy from the bag to release this power in the form of a hyperactive sugar rush!

data.name: Knight's Elder Blade
data.description: It is said that the Knights, once wielded blades that grew stronger as an enemy’s morale weakens. Time to test your knighthood!

data.name: Heather’s Boots
data.description: We stole Heather’s boots. Then, we blamed her dragon and said she ate them. The perfect plan! And now you get boots! (You’re welcome.)

data.name: Robot Guard Dog
data.description: More loyal than Hachikō, this guy will go after anyone who gets too close. Each bite does ruffly (get it?) 22 damage and lasers do 18 damage.

data.name: Skeleton Bomb
data.description: Fling deadly bone shrapnel at your enemies for fun and profit!  Okay probably just for fun.

data.name: Summer Camp Arm Floaties
data.description: Equip and you will be wearing a floatie on each of your arms. When standing idle in water, your character gently paddles his arms back and forth while floats up to the surface.

data.name: Bloxdor's Ray Gun
data.description: Speak softly and carry a big ray gun. Fire neon red laser projectiles which instantly vaporize your enemies! Very powerful so it has a pretty long reload. Part of the Bloxdor Champion of the Stars package.

data.name: Hiccup's Flaming Sword - Sponsored by HTTYD2
data.description: What every dragon trapper needs. One end coats the blade in Monstrous Nightmare saliva, the other sprays Hideous Zippleback gas!  Learn how to code your dragon - check out the video on the Bloxcon page http://www.roblox.com/event/bloxcon.

data.name: Kernel Panic Katana (1x1x1x1's)
data.description:
Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out www.roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: Staff of Healing
data.description: Asclepius, son of Apollo, Greek god of medicine grants his power to this staff. Click to heroically heal the injured.

data.name: BLOXY 2013
data.description: Lights, camera, action! This shiny BLOXY Award is awarded to the few and proud winners of ROBLOX's 2013 International Film Festival.

data.name: Alien on a Rampage Book
data.description: Every sci-fi fan needs to familiarize himself with his fellow extraterrestrials!  Collect a copy of Alien on a Rampage, a new book from Clete Smith.

data.name: Bamboo Dart Blowgun
data.description: From the infamous Shadow Ninjas of Robloxia comes this blowgun capable of firing 3 deadly darts at insane speeds.

data.name: Wyldfang the Brave Companion
data.description: Now you're a two man wolf-pack.

data.name: Wheel of the Black Pearl
data.description: The steering wheel of the legendary Black Pearl! Be sure to see Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales in theaters on May 26th!

data.name: ROBLOX Skateboard
data.description: This black and red board shreds asphalt.

data.name: Torso Cannon
data.description: Yummy yummy yummy, I've got cannons in my tummy!

data.name: Danger Mace
data.description: Swing this mace for massive damage to your opponent.  If that doesn't keep him away, surely your spiky shoulders will!

data.name: Bruin Mount
data.description: Ride in bearly affordable style. This baby bear will take you anywhere you want to go.

data.name: Arctic Fox Tail
data.description: Wear this arctic fox tail and spin to hit your enemies and deal 22.5 damage per hit.

data.name: Breakfast Gun
data.description: The ultimate in food fight technology!  Hit someone four times to make a waffle face - egg eyes, bacon smile, waffle face.

data.name: Mega Bloks ® Hot Wheels ™ Truck
data.description: Get ready for some smash & crash action with the Mega Bloks® Hot Wheels™ Baja Bone Shaker Monster Truck. Get it now!

data.name: Adventure Island
data.description: Check out the latest and best new 2D game on ROBLOX.  Explore and survive on Adventure Island!  Use "ASWD" keys to move, "W" to jump, "Enter" to shoot, and "Enter" + "W" to superjump.

data.name: Snowball
data.description: Life is like a snowball. The important thing is finding wet snow and a really long hill....

data.name: Seashell Snare
data.description: She sells seashells by the seashore.   But she doesn't mess around.  This shell is a trap that will ensnare any enemies that get too close!

data.name: Frozen Throwing Knives
data.description: Sometimes in a tight situation you have to improvise. Click to launch a knife at your foes. Does up to 22.5 damage per hit.

data.name: Kunai
data.description: The weapon is small, the danger is great.

data.name: Red Pirate Juice
data.description: Yo ho ho and a bottle or juice! Arrrg!

data.name: Blizzard Wand
data.description: Quit wishing for snow and make it happen...with this wand!    Also shoots icy blizzard balls at anyone near you.

data.name: The 7D’s Magical Royal Ruby
data.description: Use this Royal Ruby with special healing powers to create your own The 7D game! The 7D premieres Monday 7/7 @10A on Disney XD!

data.name: Staff of Eggstra Large Eggs
data.description: Summon a giant flaming egg from the sky which will crash down and fling your foe far from his current location.

data.name: Tambourine
data.description:
Hey! Mr. Tambourine Man, play a song for me, /
I'm not sleepy and there is no place I'm going to. /
Hey! Mr. Tambourine Man, play a song for me, /
In the jingle jangle morning I'll come followin' you.

data.name: Garbage Can Shield and Wooden Sword Set
data.description: Sometimes you have to improvise....

data.name: American Archer
data.description: I claim this block for America! Launch flags with wild abandon.

data.name: RobloTim's Chavez Burrito
data.description: In the same way that RobloTim loves to eat a burrito from Chavez restaurant, you love to help new users! Your place has been voted pretty gosh darn helpful!

data.name: Heart Air Balloon
data.description: Let love carry you away! Literally.  Let love carry you away in a hot air balloon.

data.name: ROBLOX Interns 2010 Mug
data.description: They say inspiration is fueled by delicious coffee...and Chavez - but that's something else altogether.

data.name: Hyperbike
data.description: Solar powered awesome motorbike.  Travel at hyperspeed and leave a trail of burning light behind you.

data.name: Sabacc Playing Cards
data.description: A deck of Sabacc cards that can be enjoyed when you watch Solo: A Star Wars Story, in theaters May 25!

data.name: Silly Guitar
data.description: Plays a nice silly tune for you - or make up your own tune!

data.name: Ruler
data.description: Because these lines can't rule themselves!

data.name: Color Paintbrush
data.description: A simple tool for changing the color of objects during Group Building

data.name: Dog Man 4 Virtual Book
data.description: Dog Man is back with the purrfect sidekick. Can the daring duo save the day? Start reading to find out!

data.name: Atmoshocker
data.description: ATMOSHOCKER!

data.name: Cliche Staff of Zombie Infection
data.description: You know what happens if this touches you.

data.name: Developer Pizza Launcher
data.description: Get a freshly delivered pizza from a developer participating in the Pizza Party event and earn an awesome prize!

data.name: Heart Balloon
data.description: Let your heart soar - as high as this balloon!

data.name: Staff of the Winds
data.description: Try it for free in the ROBLOX Thanksgiving Turkey Hunt! Hold down the left mouse button to unleash a huge gust of wind that will blow away enemies and loose parts alike!

data.name: The Gigantic Tome of Eggs
data.description: What eggs do you have? Which games contain which eggs? This tome tells you all that and more!

data.name: Korblox Evil Eye
data.description: The Korblox place their evil eye on walls or even directly on enemies to spy on them at every turn. Then when the moment is right....kaboom!

data.name: Floating Thingumajig
data.description: A truly revolutionary device that follows you no matter where you or your imagination wanders.

data.name: Korblox Deathspeaker's Spell Book
data.description: Cast one of three dangerous spells at your enemies - the Knights of Redcliff!

data.name: Tom's Beans
data.description: Inspired by an advertisement for Apocalypse Rising, a popular ROBLOX survival game, this tin of beans slowly refills 80% of your health. Plus, it gives you a special face decal when chowing down.

data.name: Katana of Destiny
data.description: Do you fulfill the sword's destiny or does it help you fulfill yours?

data.name: Bamboo Katana
data.description: Clack clack watch your back.

data.name: The Sword of Shai
data.description: Your destiny awaits!  This sword has five different attacks, each does a varying amount of damage- anywhere from 6-12 points per hit.  One's fate is often not clear - so it's fitting that this sword of fate will will obscure the vision of your foes with a sand storm when they get within 20 studs of you.

data.name: Magic Snowman
data.description: It's the most magical time of the year!  Also the coldest....

data.name: Unlucky Launcher
data.description: Shoot bad luck at your competitors by launching broken mirrors, umbrellas, and ladders at them! Upon impact, they trip onto the ground. There is a 30% chance they will temporarily be cursed with bad luck!  If they become unlucky they will suffer one of the following effects: They'll either be tripped nonstop, have a blurry screen, or have their walk speed revered so if they're walking forward, they are actually working backwards!

data.name: Robloxsai Bike
data.description: Now you can bike like Robloxsai!  Control your bike using 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', or the arrow keys.

data.name: Magnificent Lion
data.description: You've befriended the king of beasts, and now you two will ride together. Hop on and control using 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' or the arrow keys. Hit space to jump. Shift to charge; ctrl to dismount.

data.name: Quantum Entangler
data.description: Create a clone of yourself and then choose to control youself or the clone.  Be careful, when clones are created there is a shock to the entire game!

data.name: Carnagecopia
data.description: Slam other players with some pretty explosive leftovers! If you manage to hit 3 or more players, FOODPOCALYPSE mode is activated!  In FOODPOCALYPSE mode you can rapid fire for 10 seconds.

data.name: From the Vault: Kawaii Cat
data.description: From the vault of interns past, ROBLOX brings you - this kawaii cat! Rukiryo's cat will follow you around and listen to your commands. You can tell it to follow and to stay. There's also a special word to make it evolve. Will you find it?

data.name: Neon Octopus Cannon
data.description: Click to fire 8 ink shots, one from each tentacle in the direction you click!

data.name: Anubis Staff
data.description: The scales of judgement forged into a mighty weapon for Anubis' long journey. Part of the Anubis package.

data.name: billylones' ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: billylones. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Year of the Snake Lantern
data.description: Carry this lantern and let the snakes protect you.  The spirits of snake ancestors will follow you around and harm anyone they touch (everyone other than you of course!).

data.name: Eggmin Launcher 2019
data.description: Fires an exclusive egg for all time-traveling, dimension-hopping Egg Hunters. Works only in the Egg Hunt 2019: Scrambled in Time hub world. Catch these Eggmins before they hit the ground and break... fast!

data.name: DarkAge Naginata
data.description: Fight with the strength and power of the DarkAge Ninjas.

data.name: Morblox the Terrifying's Sword
data.description: You'd be afraid too... Part of the Morblox the Terrifying package.

data.name: Anti-Gravity Acorn
data.description: Use this Acorn to reach new heights as you look for a safe place to hide it! And be sure to see Ice Age: Collision Course, in theaters July 22!

data.name: Merely's Web Slinger
data.description: Nobody slings web like Merely.  Nobody. Srsly.

data.name: 2013 Firework
data.description: Ready for 2013?  Let everyone know how you feel with this explosive fire flower!

data.name: Ghost Ship
data.description: Launch a deadly ghost ship at your foes to do 60 damage.

data.name: Deep Space Raygun
data.description: The astronauts recovered this gun from a crater on an uninhabited planet. Was it lost? Or left there on purpose? Click to fire a rectangular projectile, sparks fly trailing behind as it soars through the sky toward its target.

data.name: Attack Doge
data.description: So enemies. Much bark. Wow. For those of you that don't speak doge, click on an enemy to send your attack doge after them!  His bark is worse than his bite- because he doesn't bite! Wow.

data.name: Violin Crossbow
data.description: Your music is dangerous!  Click and hold to draw and arrow.  Release the mouse to launch your arrow with great force! Each hit does between 20-30 points of damage to your foes.

data.name: TombQuest Book 1
data.description: Mummies are waking. New York is overrun with scorpions. And five Death Walkers have broken free. It’s up to one boy to stop them before it’s too late!

data.name: Theodore
data.description: The “Stomach” of the band. The only thing bigger than his belly is his kindness. As a heads up, you might not want to stand downwind of him though (he got “pizza toots”). Be sure to catch Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip in theaters December 18!

data.name: Beef Wellington Launcher
data.description: Burgers are for the common folk, but beef wellington is next level delicious. In fact, they are so delicious that your foes will eat them until it's painful and does damage.

data.name: Sten Gun
data.description: Fires 500 rounds a minute, with over-sized, 50-round clips. While the strong recoil makes it inaccurate at long ranges, you should be ashamed of yourself if you unload fifty bullets and hit nothing but air. Each bullet does 15 points of damage. Multiply that by 50 rounds and you've got enough damage to defeat more than a couple foes.

data.name: Torch
data.description: Try to set the night on fire! The updated torch looks best in ROBLOX games with dynamic lighting.

data.name: Rainbow Omega Katana
data.description: Slash and lunge at your foes with this amazing katana to do 12 to 16 points of damage.  The power of Rainbow surrounds this Katana.

data.name: Sushi Scooter
data.description: The people want sushi, and they want it now! Drive around using 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', or the arrow keys. Hit X to toggle the headlight and H to honk. Click with your mouse to grab a sushi snack from the crate on the back of the vehicle and eat it.

data.name: Patriot's Monster Truck
data.description: It is your duty to drive over all other RC cars. Anything less would be Un-American.

data.name: Golden Cobra Staff
data.description: Snakes!  Why does it always have to be snakes?

data.name: Roboarm
data.description: Your arm will have a blast when wearing the Roboarm. Roboarm blasts off and grabs whatever gear item you aim it at!

data.name: Catapult
data.description: Launching projectiles the old fashion way.

data.name: Geolocator
data.description: This military-grade geolocator is designed to withstand a 1000 foot fall. It will point true North in any environment, anywhere on the planet, with an accuracy of .0001 degrees...

data.name: Skull Cutlass
data.description: Part of the Captain Barnacle Bones package.

data.name: Pi Slicer
data.description: Slice your foes into pie slices? Sure, why not!

data.name: Darkheart
data.description: It's darker than RGB(0,0,0) and it steals life from your enemies. What more is there to say.

data.name: Zombie Friend Fred
data.description: Friends don't let friends eat brains...so maybe Fred isn't exactly your friend...

data.name: Axe of the Divine Flame
data.description: From the darkest flames, I strike at thee! Click to swing dealing 15 damage, or double click to bash the axe down in front of you, dealing twice the damage to any enemies hit!

data.name: ROBLOXIAN Damage Orb
data.description: Equip these and leave them by pressing 'Q' in your wake—they only do 20 hit points of damage to other players, but each time they hit an orb, you gain a 60% speed buff!

data.name: Worldwide Stunna
data.description: Sling the fury of the entire world at your foe.  Upon striking another person, the globe causes them to spin as the earth would. They are immobilized for several seconds.

data.name: Merely's Sparkle Time Hoverboard
data.description: Hover over the skies and speed over your challengers, sparkling all the way.

data.name: Ghostfire Throwing Daggers
data.description: Spawn several daggers and throw them at different angles to do maximum damage!

data.name: Staff of Celestial Light
data.description: Staff of wonder, staff of light, take my enemies dark as night, stop them with your celestial light.

data.name: Battle Axe
data.description: Win the battle with this awesome axe.  Features two attack modes.

data.name: Ticket Launcher
data.description: Make it rain tickets! Each ticket trips enemies and slows them down for 5 seconds.

data.name: Hot Wheels® Twinduction Car
data.description: Guide this Hot Wheels® Twinduction car around all your favorite places. Get it now!

data.name: Hunter of the Leaves Bow
data.description: Part of the Hunter of the Leaves package!  Click and hold to charge the bow; minimum damage is 15 per hit; if charged fully it can do as much as 100 damage per hit!

data.name: Eggdentifier 2010
data.description: The Eggdentifier 2010 is the latest work of the Abbitray Institute.  It identifies which eggs are in a place and how many of them there are.  A very useful egg hunting tool indeed!!!

data.name: Plad's ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: Plad. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Laser Guided Missile Launcher
data.description: Fire missiles that follow your target - press q for extra damage.

data.name: Initiate of Glorious Flight Magic Staff
data.description: This super stylish wizard staff shoots neon purple lightning! Click and hold to shoot continuous beams of lightning at for enemies. Part of the Initiate of Glorious Flight package!

data.name: 8-Bit Sword
data.description: Slash your foes into 8-bit pixels!  Click to slash and double click to lunge.

data.name: The 6th Annual Bloxy Award
data.description: A prestigious prize granted to winners of the Bloxy Awards, our yearly ceremony honoring the best and brightest of Roblox!

data.name: Kittypult
data.description: Fire fierce, angry, scratching cats at other players.  Warning - do not try this in real life.

data.name: Steampunk Slasher
data.description: An elegant weapon from a more refined time.

data.name: The Federal Reserve
data.description: Spraying cash like nobody's buisness.

data.name: Robo Arm Cannon
data.description: Sometimes, you just need a bigger boom.

data.name: Burger Launcher
data.description: Fire deadly burgers and fries at your foes!  They'll take some serious burger damage (25 points per hit) and massive fry devastation (35 damage per hit)!

data.name: Emerald Claw: The Envious Club
data.description: Im not sure where he got this, I don't think I want to know either... Click to bash this upon your enemies heads! Dealing 20 to 30 damage! You will either whack your enemy or swing overhead. Double click to forcefully swing from above; dealing massive damage and temporarily stunning them!  Part of the Emerald Claw: The Envious package.

data.name: Fundroid Blaster
data.description: Part of the Fundroid package - a GameStop exclusive - http://www.roblox.com/Fundroid-item?id=114552623

data.name: Icicle Cannon
data.description: The perfect gift for super villians everywhere. This medium to long-range weapon shoots icy spikes at your enemies. The spikes explode and do splash damage. Wicked cool.

data.name: Magical Unicorn
data.description:
"Always, I wanna be with you / And make believe with you / And live in harmony" Fly your very own unicorn through the skies of ROBLOX.  An awesome rainbow trail marks where you've been. 
Use the 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' or the arrow keys to control your magical friend.

data.name: Summer Games - Soccer Ball
data.description: Life is simple: eat, sleep, play soccer.

data.name: Chimp Friend
data.description: Chimp friend? Or chimp fiend?

data.name: Non-Hovering Board
data.description: Some people might think this is a skateboard, but they'd be wrong. This is just a hover board that's missing its hover functionality.

data.name: Freeze Ray
data.description: Stop your enemies in their tracks and freeze them in a giant block of ice.

data.name: Stinky Skunk
data.description: This stinky guy will knock your foes to the ground!

data.name: Part Dragger

data.name: Bundle of TNT
data.description: Industrially, TNT is synthesized in a three-step process. First, toluene is nitrated with a mixture of sulfuric and nitric acid to produce mono-nitrotoluene or MNT. The MNT is separated and then renitrated to dinitrotoluene or DNT. In the final step, the DNT is nitrated to trinitrotoluene or TNT using an anhydrous mixture of nitric acid and oleum. Nitric acid is consumed by the manufacturing process, but the diluted sulfuric acid can be reconcentrated and reused. Subsequent to nitration, TNT is stabilized by a process called sulphitation, where the crude TNT is treated with aqueous sodium sulfite solution in order to remove less stable isomers of TNT and other undesired reaction products. The rinse water from sulphitation is known as red water and is a significant pollutant and waste product of TNT manufacture.
