data.description: This trophy stands as proof that this user earned the old school (think stone age) item that was available during a 2016 event.

data.name: Saxophone
data.description: Saxomaphone....saxomaphone..tubamaphone?

data.name: Newtrat's Tuskinator
data.description: Tuskies are your chums, spam them on your friends, watch them stick like glue, spewing wishes all the time.

data.name: Rainbow Blaster
data.description: This is advertising. But that don’t matter - does it, Hot Shot? This is a dandy blaster that’s loaded with the full spectrum of colour! Bang.

data.name: Teddy Trap
data.description: So many lulz! You have to be a little clever to figure out the best way to use it... heh heh.

data.name: Year of the Dog Lantern
data.description: Happy Lunar New Year! Celebrate with your own ghostly guard dog to protect you.

data.name: Endless Summer Fireworks
data.description: Just one click and you're in for a huge fireworks display!  This firework will reload every 5 seconds so the fun never has to stop!.

data.name: ROBLOX Birthday Cake 2010
data.description: Celebrate our birthday with this delicious birthday cake gear!

data.name: Horde of Attack Crabs
data.description: Summon five tiny crabs which will run after enemies and pinch them with their claws dealing damage! They'll chase anybody nearby and you click on.

data.name: Blobby
data.description: Fear the mighty blob! Just kidding, it is only Blobby – everyone’s favorite sentient, scooter riding, gelatinous ooze! Find both the Dennis Bat and Drac Bat somewhere on ROBLOX and get Blobby after the event closes on 01/19/2016!

data.name: Steamgun
data.description: This powerful steamgun emits... you guessed it... steam!  Shoot a stream of steam at your foes to do damage.

data.name: Skeletal Sword
data.description: Victory comes with a price.  Get this exclusive sword when you redeem a $25 ROBLOX card from Walmart by February 28th.

data.name: Magic Dragon
data.description: Little Jackie Paper grew up to be an arsonist. Sad but true.

data.name: Red ROBLOX Glider
data.description: Soar through the skies. It's definitely the most scenic way to travel!

data.name: Christmas Tree Ornament
data.description: Shoot these at a Christmas tree to decorate it!

data.name: Military Remote Control Plane
data.description: Now you're ready for the ultimate reconnaissance mission!

data.name: Roped
data.description: Travel around the level on your motorized Roped.

data.name: Neon Tiger Mount
data.description: Gaudy, fierce, and fast - the purrr-fect mount.

data.name: The Luck O' the Irish
data.description: You just got McPwned.

data.name: Roblox Pom-Poms
data.description: Cheer on your favorite team, or anything, with these pom-poms!

data.name: Radical Orange Skateboard
data.description: This free gear item brought to you as part of our current Skate Park building contest promotion!

data.name: Spider Slasher
data.description: Click to slash double-click to lunge and do 12 damage. When you lunge, you also shoot a web in the the direction of your cursor. If it hits somebody, their speed is reduced to 6 for a few seconds, giving you an opportunity to catch up to them. While slashing your enemy with the sword, there is a 30% chance of poisoning them!

data.name: Haunted Pumpkin Staff
data.description: Summon tons of pumpkins with just the twirl of your staff!  Watch out the darkseeds are especially dangerous.

data.name: Eight Bit Marvel
data.description: Who knew eight bits could do so much!

data.name: Regeneration Coil
data.description: The latest in the power coils family - the health regeneration coil will help you regenerate your health quickly.

data.name: Swarm of Bats
data.description: Your loyal bat colony will follow you and do your bidding.  Click a player within a 100 stud radius and the your swarm of bats descends upon them - doing 5 damage per hit. These bats are not just any common colony, they are also trained to do a special attack.  Press 'Q' to begin firing bats forward from your arms, which deal 5 damage per hit.

data.name: Egg Magnet
data.description: This powerful egg magnetic pulls metal eggs towards you as soon as you are close enough to the egg for the magnetic attraction begin. You'll have to experiment to determine which eggs are metallic...

data.name: Eggphone
data.description: This standard-issue cellular device contains information about your next mission. Good luck, agents!

data.name: Four-In-A-Row
data.description: Play a quick game of Four-In-A-Row with a nearby player! (Get close to another player and click on them to start a game - they need to accept your challenge for the game to start)

data.name: 8-Bit Frog Friend
data.description: A faithful friend who follows you around, just keep him away from the road.

data.name: Anger Management Phone Book
data.description: RAAAAAWWWWWWWWWWRRRRRRR!  Phone book makes me so angry!

data.name: Ornate Katana
data.description: Never sacrifice form for function, go for both.

data.name: Hot Potato
data.description: Left click to activate, then pass it off before it explodes!

data.name: ROBLOX U Moped
data.description: The ROBLOX University campus is huge!  You'll need this moped to get around quickly.

data.name: Phoenix
data.description: Equip the Phoenix and watch as it flies around you in a defensive circle, shooting at nearby enemies (25 damage per hit) for as long as five minutes. You can even have the Phoenix target specific enemies by clicking on them.

data.name: Club Boates Disco Ball
data.description: Summon your very own club and dance anywhere!

data.name: Candy Cane Launcher
data.description: Need some holiday cheer? Say hello to my little friend! Rapid fire launch candy canes at anyone who stands in your way.  Does 5 damage per hit.

data.name: Bad Bad Bunny
data.description: Bad Bad Bunny likes to confuse egg hunters with his explosive decoy eggs!

data.name: Icy Spiky Club
data.description: Rawr...me hit you with club.

data.name: Crimson Katana of the Unsetting Sun
data.description: If not for victory and honor, then what?

data.name: Spec Chi Biograft Energy Sword
data.description: After the Christmas wars of 3010 all promised never to forget. People knew they must remain vigilant to protect against the revolt of the Santa bots and the factory elves.  This sword was specially designed to protect against festive robots of all seasons.

data.name: Dragon's Flame Sword
data.description: Are you the dragon or the dragon slayer?  Use the special key 'E', 'Q', 'G', 'T', 'L' to emit ice-fire from your left arm and throw fire balls at your foes.  If hit, your enemy will be set aflame and and will take 70 damage.

data.name: Xanwood Katana
data.description: Who ever heard of a wooden Katana? Click to swing; does 8 damage.

data.name: Instant Treehouse
data.description: Part of the fun of summer is hanging out 24/7.  Now you have a place to hang out wherever you go.

data.name: Lance’s Energy Blaster
data.description: The bayard weapon of the fun loving Blue Lion pilot, Lance. Be careful with this, hot shot! (It packs a punch).

data.name: Flayed Rats
data.description: These rats are up to something...but what? Stranger Things 3 premieres July 4 only on Netflix.

data.name: Tiger's Wrath Sword
data.description: ROAR!  Attack your foes with the speed of a tiger. If you are able to slay 5 foes with this mighty sword, you will be able to use its special Tiger Raig attack- which lets you slash over and over again and creates a red danger circle that will do damage to anyone within it.

data.name: Celtic Throwing Stars
data.description: Small enough to hide in a leprechaun's pocket, deadly enough to belong in an assassin's.

data.name: Viridian Hoverboard
data.description: Roll in high fashion with this stylish viridian board.

data.name: Balloon Tank
data.description: This tank looks silly, but is capable of doing some serious damage.  To move the tank hold the W or S key while moving your mouse in the direction you would like it to follow. When you click, the tank fires balloons which are random colors. If a player is hit by a balloon, they are dealt 25 damage. There is a 1.5 second reload time.

data.name: 7-Eleven Slurpee
data.description: Get this 7-Eleven Slurpee for free when you redeem a 7-Eleven ROBLOX Card in the month of July!

data.name: Rare Egg Compass - Egg Hunt 2013
data.description: This item will only work in the official ROBLOX Egg Hunt 2013 level for the duration of this year's egg hunt.  This item will help you find one of three rare eggs.

data.name: Dory Lantern
data.description: Congratulations, you found the Dory Lantern. Let it light up your way wherever you travel! Be sure to see Finding Dory in theatres June 17 in 3D

data.name: Long-Range Proton Crossbow
data.description: Damage your enemies with the crossbow of tomorrow, today.

data.name: Poison Picnic
data.description: This green cake with a skull on it is irresistible.  Does 60 damage to any opponent who picks it up.  Why would they pick it up you say?  Because they have no other choice.

data.name: Radiant Seahorse
data.description:
"I only travel by seahorse these days. All the best people are doing it!"

Use the arrow keys or 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' to steer your seahorse in whichever direction you'd like to go.

data.name: Emerald Knights of the Seventh Sanctum Staff
data.description: Use the magical power of Emeralds to immobilize and shock your target!

data.name: Scrooge McDuck’s Sun Chaser Plane
data.description: The famed plane of Scrooge McDuck! It has seen countless adventures (and survived even more crashes at the hands of Launchpad).

data.name: Eveningstar: Bringer of Dusk
data.description: Legend tells of a cursed mace appearing in conflicts from time immemorial. A terrible darkness radiates from it as whispers swarm your mind.

data.name: Exponential Rocket Launcher
data.description: One rocket. Three rockets. Nine rockets.  The further your initial rocket travels, the more rockets it spawns, causing anywhere from 75 to 300 points of damage on impact, resulting in catastrophic damage for anyone that isn’t you.

data.name: Positronic Arm Cannon
data.description: From the research labs of scientifically advanced Robloxia comes this attachable cannon to blasts your opponents with not 1, not 2 but 3 fully charged rotating positron charges

data.name: 2010 Roman Candle
data.description: Happy New Years!

data.name: Happy New Year Horse
data.description: The Year of the Horse is a time of fast victories and unexpected adventure.

data.name: Virtual Book – Harry Potter
data.description: Start your adventure today with Harry Potter!

data.name: Cupid's Revenge
data.description: Love hurts.  No it doesn't really, but these arrows do!

data.name: Ice Staff
data.description: Click on a location within 64 studs of your character to create a large wall of ice. The ice is slippery and nigh impossible to climb. Use it to block off corridors and routes of escape!

data.name: DarkAge Ninjas: Dual Kamas
data.description: Fast and Elegant. Strike at the hearts of your enemies or spin like the hurricane destroying anything and everything in your path!

data.name: Squid Ink Bomb
data.description: Your enemies won't be able to see clearly!  Literally! This rapid firing squid throws ink balls at your foes and fills their screen up with ink splats.

data.name: Momo Companion
data.description: Go on and explore the wonderful neon world with your best pal, Momo and be sure to watch Netflix’s New Movie Next Gen on Friday, September 7.

data.name: Vaulting Pole
data.description: Victory is only one jump away.

data.name: The Merry Avenger
data.description: His vengeance is swift and just..... and merry!

data.name: Bombo's Bow and Arrow
data.description: Killer instincts lead to killer arrows.

data.name: Badblox Hatchling - Hatched Egg of Duty
data.description: Badblox Hatchling came out of the Egg of Duty from the 2013 Egg Hunt.

data.name: Bear Arm
data.description: You have the right to bear arms and to bear other people's arms...yeah it's literal.

data.name: Red Balloon
data.description:
Hast Du etwas Zeit für mich /
Dann singe ich ein Lied fuer Dich /
Von 99 Luftballons /
Auf ihrem Weg zum Horizont /
Denkst Du vielleicht grad' an mich /
Dann singe ich ein Lied fuer Dich /
Von 99 Luftballons /
Und dass sowas von sowas kommt

data.name: Dual Katanas of the DarkAge Clan
data.description: These ancient katanas have been passed down from generation to generation of DarkAge ninjas.  Only the most agile may learn to wield the dual katanas.

data.name: Rainbow Disco Hyperbike with Sidecar
data.description: Take a friend on your crazy hyperbike adventures!

data.name: Icedagger
data.description:
"Is this a dagger which I see before me,
"The handle toward my hand? Come, let me clutch thee. /
I have thee not, and yet I see thee still. /
Art thou not, fatal vision, sensible / 
To feeling as to sight? or art thou but /
A dagger of the mind, a false creation, /
Proceeding from the heat-oppressed brain?"

data.name: Attack Racket
data.description: They can't hit what they can't touch! Swing this tennis racket, firing flaming tennis balls at your opponent! If hit, the tennis balls deal 20 damage per hit.

data.name: Warrior of the Wood's Sword
data.description: Part of the Warrior of the Woods Package.  Each swing does 20, 25, 15, or 30 damage. If you're hit by the sword without it being swung,  Hit Q to make it rain swords to protect you from your foes for 15 seconds.

data.name: Scythe
data.description:
The Scythe has a huge variety of moves.  

 'q' key = swipe left
'e' key = swipe right
click once = normal strike
double click = double strike
"fgh" = spin attack of great doom

data.name: 8-Bit Duck Friend
data.description: No need to hunt for this duck, this faithful friend will spawn on click and follow you around. Click around nearby and he'll fly to that designated spot as well.

data.name: Panda’s Cellphone
data.description: Trying to fit in with humans isn’t easy when you’re a bear. But having a phone helps. You must be pretty cool if Panda gave it to you!

data.name: Roman Sword and Shield
data.description: FOR THE EMPIRE!

data.name: Bo Staff 7000
data.description: Use this futuristic Bo Staff to slash at your foes and do 15 damage.  Hit 'Q' to activate its special ability - a forcefield that instantly kills your foes.

data.name: Opened ROBLOX Basket of Self Eggspression
data.description: "But mom, metal music is how I eggspress myself!" Inside you find... Eggcelent ROBLOX Headphones.

data.name: Pyrox's Flame Staff
data.description: Pyrox’s flame staff burns everyone in his way. Earn this prize in the LEGO Hero Factory: Brain Attack! game - http://www.roblox.com/LEGO-Hero-Factory-Brain-Attack-place?id=88419564.

data.name: Gear Cloner
data.description: This device will clone your gear so that you can share it with a teammate or friend.

data.name: Sword of the Seas
data.description: Click to slash at your foes and deal 15 damage.  When you are tired of this, unleash the wrath of the waves upon your foes with the special attack key 'Q'

data.name: Jack Sparrow’s Compass
data.description:
Use the compass of Captain Jack Sparrow to guide you and be sure to see Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales in theaters on May 26th!

**Grand Prize will be awarded on May 31st after completion of Event**

data.name: Flaming Dragon Slayer Bo Staff
data.description: Made from the talons of previously slayed dragons.  How he slayed the first one, I'll never know!

data.name: Pilgrim's Blunderbuss
data.description: Because turkeys don't hunt themselves...

data.name: Fairy Axe
data.description: Your enemies won't know what hit them!  Or how!  Or why!

data.name: REKTangle Board
data.description: All I ever want to do is skate. With this REKTangle board that is no problem!

data.name: Hedgehog Friend
data.description: Why can't they just share the hedge?

data.name: Scatterblaster
data.description: Think of it as a one-handed shotgun from the future. Good against masses of enemies, especially in tight corridors.

data.name: Spell Book of Ice Cold Revenge
data.description: Revenge is a dish best served cold. This spell lets you deliver vengeance in the coldest form: ice.

data.name: Banana Peel
data.description: Always slippery in cartoons, but are they ever in real life?  I don't know, but they sure are hilarious!

data.name: Inugami: Ninja Warrior
data.description: Ninja dogs stay hidden in the barkness. This faithful friend follows your every step, remaining in your shadow, waiting for the right moment to strike...

data.name: Incredibles 2 Badge
data.description: This is a signet justice and activating it lets you pursue evil even faster! Be sure to see Disney/Pixar’s Incredibles 2, in theatres June 15!

data.name: Orinthian Falcon
data.description: A noble guardian to help protect you on your quest.  And by protect, I mean attack all enemies.  Circles above you and attacks those enemies unfortunate enough to be selected as his prey.  This falcon is from the future and features 5 different attack modes.

data.name: Love Hurts Ray Gun
data.description: Love is like a ray gun - it'll burn you if you're not paying attention.

data.name: Hypnocannon
data.description: You're getting very sleepy!  And slow!  You're in control with the hypnocannon!

data.name: Bluesea Soarer
data.description: This powerful blue dragon will follow you around and shoot fiery death balls at your enemies.

data.name: Gravitron 3000
data.description: Toss this to negate gravity for everyone but yourself.

data.name: Touchdown Football
data.description: What do you do after you score a touchdown?  Spike that ball and dance like there's no tomorrow.

data.name: 10/9 - Zombie Escape Scooter
data.description: Zombies are coming and you are going to make it out alive! You knew this was going to happen and were prepared!  Click to throw out some zombie bait (brains) which will divert any zombies chasing you. Then scoot on outta there!

data.name: The Christmas Creep
data.description: You know when you start seeing Christmas stuff in stores in late September. It's HIS fault.

data.name: Zombie Slayer
data.description: Because if you don't -who will?

data.name: Cloud 9 Snowboard
data.description: You’re the fastest snowboarder around!  You can win this snowboard by playing the Cloud 9 Snowboarding game on ROBLOX – http://www.roblox.com/Cloud-9-Snowboarding-Game-place?id=140438051. The new Disney Channel Original Movie Cloud 9 premieres Friday JaNEWary 17 at 8P.

data.name: Virtual BLOXcon Power Sword
data.description: This sword is part of the Virtual BLOXcon Power Armor package.

data.name: 2010 Fireworks
data.description: Always remember, ROBLOX fireworks are fun, but real fireworks are dangerous. Don't play with real fireworks unless a responsible adult is present.

data.name: Diamond Blade Sword
data.description: What cuts like diamond? Nothing. Swing this super powerful sword over your head.  As it sparkles around you, the sword does powerful damage to your foe. If you manage to blox them, they will turn into a diamond as they fall apart.

data.name: hicup789's ROBLOX Tablet
data.description: Winner: hicup789. ROBLOX will be in touch to redeem this prize. Void if sold, traded, or deleted.

data.name: Bald Eagle
data.description: America's proud symbol flies above you and protects you with the very latest Amerilaser defense... or offense depending on how you look at it.

data.name: Fiery Dragon Axe - a Target exclusive item!
data.description: This dragon axe will have your enemies begging for mercy.  Get this item when you redeem a ROBLOX Card from Target after October 24th.

data.name: The Awe Star
data.description: Awe... SNAP! As of November 13, 2009 there are exactly equal numbers of Awe Stars and Ninja Masks of Awesomeness in existence. If you combine both items, the Awe Star becomes a weapon of Ninjitsu domination!

data.name: Gravitational Radiation Hammer v0.01
data.description: Utilizing the latest in subspace/molecular deformation technology for mining on the planet Ysteb, the Gravity Hammer will expel objects surrounding its user in an outward vector. Warning: currently the Gravity Hammer does not work on objects that contain anchoritium.

data.name: Knight's Sword
data.description: Keep down the peasant uprisings with this gleaming longsword.

data.name: Orinthian Bow
data.description: Get this with the Orinthian Soldier Package - http://www.roblox.com/item.aspx?seoname=Orinthian-Soldier&id=111514918

data.name: Leland the Lolturtle
data.description: Leland does it for the lulz.

data.name: Yellow Card
data.description: Unsportmanlike Conduct!  One more time and you're out of here!

data.name: Gearworks Sword
data.description: A swift sword that does 12 to 18 damage per hit. Watch out for the steam though!

data.name: Frying Pan
data.description: Not the mama! Hahahahaha

data.name: 1337 R0807
data.description: Its a head, with a mouth that shoots Rockets?? Classic Cannon head!

data.name: Wanwood Sword Cane
data.description:
Get this exclusive item when you redeem a code from a Roblox toy!

Check out www.roblox.com/toys to learn more...

data.name: R0b0-Penguin
data.description: Warning: Core Temp Unstable. Faithfully follows, releasing ice and electricity as he goes.

data.name: Anti-Ballistics Force Field
data.description: This force field deflects most projectiles launched at you and sends them sailing back at your opponents. What’s more, the reflected projectiles do an additional 50 damage points.

data.name: Sir Lancelot’s Sword
data.description: Do centuries amounts of damage with this sword.  Exclusively fit for a Knight of the roundtable. Check out Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb in theaters December 19th!

data.name: ROBLOX U Foam Finger
data.description: Root, root, root for the home team!  Raise your foam finger in victory and high five other fans!

data.name: Glory Launcher 2012
data.description: With this heat seeking missile launcher, your foes don't stand a chance.

data.name: Sword of Glowing Hope
data.description: Even in the deepest darkness, there is hope in the flash of my blade. This sword is lit up so it's bright in dark places and slightly glows. Slash at your enemies dealing 17 damage per hit. Upon slashing enemies, sparks emit out of the sword. Anybody killed will burst into neon green flame particles and vanish.

data.name: Snowplow
data.description: Click on a player to chase them with your snowplow and push them away from you.

data.name: Boxing Glove Launcher
data.description: Shoot dangerous boxing gloves at your foes.  They'll probably see it coming... but that's half the fun!

data.name: Trophy of Participation 2016
data.description: This trophy stands as proof that this user earned the dino-tastic item that was available during a 2016 event.

data.name: BB-9E
data.description: A mysterious droid in the service of the First Order that surely has a trick or two when it comes to stopping its enemies.

data.name: Festive Artemis Bow
data.description: Because- why not? When fired, arrows leave a candy cane beam trailing behind. Randomly colored ornaments spawn around where the arrow hit. This is one festive range attacked!

data.name: Darksteel Katana of Ancient Illuminators
data.description: It shall not break, it shall not bend. If you think you can avoid its explosion, your time is at an end. Use the 'A' 'W' and 'D' keys to create an explosion that will leave your opponents reeling!

data.name: Spec Epsilon Biograft Energy Sword
data.description: The superintelligent cloud people of the distant future find the history of human conflict hilarious and ironic. To that end, they created these weapons to sell in museum gift shops as a living reminder of the pinnacle of human stupidity. (WHY DO YOU NEED HAND TO HAND WEAPONS WHEN YOU HAVE LAZORS?!) Because the cloud people are incorporeal, the swords are completely harmless and they allow their young to play with them.

data.name: From the Vault: Alligator Plushie
data.description: From the vault of interns past, ROBLOX brings you - an angry alligator! ZolarKeth's alligator launches into the air and retrieves a basketball from the nether. The alligator then follows the player at a maximum speed of seventeen.

data.name: Dagger of Shattered Dimensions
data.description: At first stab, it appears to be an ordinary dagger. But one quick press of the 'Q' key proves it to be something quite different.  Something that shatters dimensions.  Particularly the dimension of time.

data.name: Attrition Blade
data.description: Your enemies won't last long with this blade on your side.

data.name: Dragon Slayer Knight's Sword
data.description: Ready your sword for battle! Click to slash and lunge at your enemies! Dealing 16 to 20 damage per hit! Swings very ferociously dealing lots of damage. Upon killing enemies; their limbs turn ash black and burst all over! Part of the Dragon Slayer Knight package.

data.name: Roman Candle
data.description: Remember to enjoy fireworks responsibly.
